plugins.description: DSH plugin: remap Enter, Ctrl+Enter and Shift+Enter to line break, send, or busy-time send.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-enter-remap

Remap <kbd>Enter</kbd> / <kbd>Ctrl+Enter</kbd> / <kbd>Shift+Enter</kbd> in the DSH composer into any of three actions — line break, send, and busy-time send. There is no settings page: the mapping comes from three values in `cordis.patch.yml`. The plugin never sends messages, never edits your draft, and never writes to DSH's own files.

DSH 插件：把输入框的 Enter、Ctrl+Enter、Shift+Enter 重映射为换行、发送或繁忙时发送。

## 安装

从 npm：

```bash
dsh plugin add dsh-enter-remap
```

从本地目录 / 源码：

```bash
dsh plugin add ./dsh-enter-remap
```

装完重启 DSH，在「设置 → 插件」里能看到它；回到输入框按一下 Enter，变成换行就说明生效了。

## 兼容性

- 需要支持插件包（`dsh.bundle`）的 DSH 版本。只使用公开扩展点：宿主侧监听 `webserver/index-inject` 事件，客户端侧通过 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load` 注册一个 web 客户端插件。
- 不依赖任何 `@deepseek-ai/*` 运行时包，也不 import DSH 内部模块，因此不受 DSH 小版本升级影响。
- 客户端只在 DSH 输入框（Lexical 编辑器，选择器 `[data-lexical-editor="true"]`）上监听按键。如果将来 DSH 更换输入框实现，插件的按键改写会失效、行为回到原生，但不会报错，也不会损坏会话。
- 在 DSH desktop（Windows）上验证过；macOS / Linux 未逐平台测试，原理上等价。

## 工作原理

DSH 原生已经有这三种动作：Enter 发送（忙时按「设置 → 通用 → Composer Enter」决定 queue/steer），Ctrl+Enter 发送（互补投递），Shift+Enter 换行。本插件只在页面捕获阶段改写按键，把它换成目标动作对应的原生组合键，再交给 DSH 自己的 keymap 执行。插件不发送消息、不改草稿、不改任何 DSH 设置。

## 配置

配置在 `cordis.patch.yml` 的 `config` 里：

```yaml
config:
  enter: newline      # Enter
  ctrlEnter: send     # Ctrl+Enter
  shiftEnter: busySend # Shift+Enter
```

可选值：

| 值 | 行为 |
| --- | --- |
| `newline` | 换行（沿用原生 Shift+Enter） |
| `send` | 发送行为（沿用原生 Enter；忙时执行「通用 → 繁忙时的发送行为」选中的排队/插话） |
| `busySend` | 繁忙时的发送行为（沿用原生 Ctrl+Enter；忙时执行另一条投递方式） |

默认配置是一次三键轮换：Enter 换行，Ctrl+Enter 发送（忙时按通用设置），Shift+Enter 发送（忙时用另一种投递）。空闲时两个发送键都会把消息发到会话，差别只体现在繁忙时的排队/插话方式。

两个"发送"语义不同，配置时注意：`send` 走**非加速** Enter（模型忙时按「繁忙时的发送行为」设置决定 queue/steer）；`busySend` 走**加速** Ctrl+Enter（模型忙时总是执行与设置相反的那一种）。想让某个键"忙时固定排队"或"忙时固定插话"，用 Ctrl+Enter 侧的那个值配合设置一起调。

改完配置后重启 DSH 生效。页面上没有设置入口，重装或升级插件不会覆盖你的配置。

## 边界情况

- `/`、`@` 之类的补全菜单打开时，Enter 原样交给菜单仲裁（选中高亮项；没高亮项时仍会发送），不会被改写成换行。
- `Alt` / `AltGr`（含 Windows 上的 `Ctrl+Alt`）、`Ctrl+Meta+Enter`、`Shift+Ctrl/Meta+Enter` 保持 DSH 原生行为（原生会吞掉或直接放行），不参与重映射。
- 输入法合成中（`isComposing` / keyCode 229）以及合成结束后的 10ms 窗口内（与 DSH 原生 `recentlyComposing` 一致）不做改写，交给浏览器与 DSH 原生处理，避免中文确认回车多出换行。
- 长按产生的自动重复会原样透传给 DSH，发送类按键因此只触发一次（与原生键一致）。
- 配置在每次按键时读取，所以运行期直接改 `window.__DSH_ENTER_REMAP__` 立即生效；但改 `cordis.patch.yml` 仍需重启 DSH。

## 卸载

```bash
dsh plugin remove dsh-enter-remap
```

重启 DSH 后输入框恢复原生键位。插件不写用户数据、不改 DSH 设置，配置只存在于插件自己的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里，卸载后不留残留。

## 开发说明

本插件在 AI 辅助下编写，功能设计、边界情况的判断与测试由作者负责并持续维护。

This plugin was written with AI assistance. Its design, edge-case decisions and testing are the author's responsibility, and it is maintained by the author.

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.description: Seat-based multi-agent orchestration for DeepSeek Harness - a port of oh-my-opencode-slim (omo-slim) onto DSH native seams.
plugins.readme_text:
# oh-my-dsh

A seat-based multi-agent orchestration bundle for **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)**.

It ports the agent design of **[oh-my-opencode-slim](https://github.com/alvinunreal/oh-my-opencode-slim)** — the "omo-slim" pantheon of specialised agents — onto DSH's own seams: sessions, session projections, the tool runtime, and the subagent seam. Everything ships inside this bundle; **no official package is modified**.

> **Derived from**: this project is an adaptation of **oh-my-opencode-slim** (by *Boring Dystopia Development*, MIT licensed). The seat roster, personas, routing model and skill set are ported from that project; the DSH-side integration is original. See [Credits & License](#credits--license).

[English](#english) · [简体中文](#简体中文)

---

# English

## What it is

oh-my-opencode-slim's idea is simple: instead of forcing one model to do everything, route each part of the job to the agent best suited for it, balancing quality, speed and cost. This bundle implements that idea on DeepSeek Harness:

- **Eight specialised seats** — Orchestrator, Explorer, Fixer, Oracle, Designer, Council, Councillor, Observer — each with a persona and a real tool policy (read-only seats physically cannot write or spawn lanes).
- **A seat plane that lives beside DSH's official modes.** Seats are *not* agent presets: they are defined in the bundle's own seat table, dispatched as isolated lanes by the `omo_dispatch` tool, or applied to a session by the seat runtime. The official preset picker keeps showing only its own four modes.
- **Per-lane model routing** — each dispatch can name its own `provider`/`model`; when it does not, the seat's configured default applies; with neither, the lane inherits the parent session's *current* route.
- **A human-facing control surface** — the Agent chip in the composer row switches the session's seat and carries a per-seat "dispatch default model" editor.

## Features

### The seat table

| Seat | Role | Tool policy |
|---|---|---|
| `orchestrator` | Plans, delegates, reconciles and verifies | full (fs, search, shell, delegation) |
| `explorer` | Read-only codebase recon + external research | read-only (no write/edit/shell) |
| `fixer` | Bounded implementation of well-specified changes | fs + search + shell |
| `oracle` | Architecture, risk, debugging strategy, review | read-only |
| `designer` | UI/UX implementation and visual polish | fs + search + shell |
| `council` | Multi-model consensus synthesis | **zero tools** (allow-list `[]`) |
| `councillor` | One independent, read-only council vote | read-only, no delegation |
| `observer` | Visual analysis of images / PDFs / diagrams | read-only |

Tool policies are enforced at the **execution layer**, not just in the prompt: inherited tools are masked with `tools.restrict()`, and tools the session registered into its own scope are refused per call by a `tools.guard()` that reads the execution's tool name and re-checks the resolved definition. A tool registered after the seat landed is refused too.

### Dispatch, not prompts

The Orchestrator delegates through the `omo_dispatch` tool: one call = one isolated lane with the seat's persona, tool policy and model route. Independent lanes run in parallel, a lineage event records the relationship, and the parent receives the lane's final answer in a completion notice. The multi-model **Council** works the same way: councillor seats answer the same question on different models, then the zero-tool council seat synthesises the verdict.

### Seat model preferences

Each seat can carry a **dispatch-default model** — the model a lane uses when the dispatch does not name one. Configuration is layered and explicit:

1. dispatch call arguments (a full `provider` + `model` pair) — highest priority;
2. a user-level override file (`<DSH_HOME>/omo/seat-models.json`) with three states per seat: *use the seat default*, *force inherit the parent route*, or *this exact route*;
3. the seat definition's own default (in the shipped table or in `<DSH_HOME>/omo/presets.json` for user seats);
4. else the parent session's current route.

The override file is re-read on every dispatch (saving applies to the next dispatch, not to running lanes), written atomically under a cross-process lock with per-entry compare-and-swap, and never silently flattened when corrupt. The Agent chip's **Model** button edits it through a small typed Remote (`omoSeatModels`) — no JSON editing required.

### Skills

Twelve skills are ported from omo-slim (`deepwork`, `codemap`, `verification-planning`, `reflect`, `ai-estimates`, `deanchor`, `step-back`, `simplify`, `worktrees`, `clonedeps`, `loop-engineering`, and the `oh-my-dsh` meta-skill). Seats mount `skill-filesystem` + `tool-skill`, so every omo seat sees them in its skill catalog and loads them on demand.

### Commands

- `omo_dispatch` (tool) — dispatch one seat as a lane.
- `/preset [<seat-id>]` — list the omo seats and official modes, or switch this session's seat.

## Requirements

- **DeepSeek Harness** desktop `0.2.1-rc.2` or newer (CLI `0.2.0-rc.2` also works for the host side).
- The bundle declares these peers, resolved from the host: `@deepseek-ai/cordis`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-atomic-write`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-typert-protocol`, `zod`.
- For per-lane model routing you need at least two registered provider routes, and the profile must allow them for the session that dispatches.
- The **Model** editor needs the bundle's client half (the Agent chip) to be mounted.

## Install

```text
plugin_manager → action: install_bundle → target: <absolute path to this directory>
```

or use the desktop GUI's **Plugins** page. The bundle's patch adds three rows:

- `command-preset` — the `/preset` command;
- `omo-dispatch` — the seat table, the `omo_dispatch` tool, the `omoSeats` session projection and the seat runtime;
- `omo-model-settings` — the `omoSeatModels` Remote that backs the model editor.

The patch also overrides the host's `subagent-model-selection-settings` row so the official `subagent` tool exposes routing parameters.

After installing, start a new session, open the Agent chip in the composer row, and pick a seat.

## Notes and limitations

- **Seats are not presets.** The official preset picker will never show them, and switching a seat does not change the session's model — that stays with the official model selector.
- Switching to an official mode from the picker lifts the omo layer for that session.
- The seat table is read from disk; user seats come from `<DSH_HOME>/omo/presets.json` and share the same `/preset` and chip surface.
- The model editor only affects **future lane dispatches**; already-running lanes keep their model.
- A council needs at least two distinct models in the profile; with fewer, it degrades to single-model consensus.
- The bundle needs a restart to pick up a new `presets.json` (user seats), while seat model preferences apply from the next dispatch without a restart.

## Credits & License

**MIT.** This project is a **derivative work adapted from [oh-my-opencode-slim](https://github.com/alvinunreal/oh-my-opencode-slim)**, an OpenCode agent-orchestration plugin by *Boring Dystopia Development* (author: [alvinunreal](https://github.com/alvinunreal)), released under the MIT License. The seat personas, routing philosophy and the twelve skills originate there. The DeepSeek Harness integration — seat runtime, tool-policy enforcement, session projections, the `omoSeatModels` Remote and the Agent chip — is written for this bundle.

The original MIT license notice is preserved in [LICENSE](LICENSE).

---

# 简体中文

## 这是什么

oh-my-opencode-slim（omo-slim）的核心想法很简单：不要逼一个模型干所有事，而是把工作拆给最适合的 agent，在质量、速度与成本之间取平衡。本 bundle 把这一设计移植到 **DeepSeek Harness（DSH）**：

- **八个专职席位**——总管（Orchestrator）、侦察（Explorer）、实现（Fixer）、顾问（Oracle）、设计（Designer）、议会（Council）、议员（Councillor）、观察（Observer），每个席位都有独立人格与**真实的工具策略**（只读席位在机制上无法写文件或派生子 agent）。
- **席位平面与 DSH 官方模式并存。** 席位不是 agent preset：它们定义在 bundle 自己的席位表里，由 `omo_dispatch` 工具派成隔离 lane，或由席位运行时叠加到当前会话。官方模式选择器始终只显示它自己的四个模式。
- **按 lane 指定模型**——每次派发可自带 `provider`/`model`；不传则用席位配置的默认模型；两者都没有时，lane 继承父会话**当前*

plugins.description: 道一-易经推演 · 通用决策评审 DSH 插件（决策辅助，非迷信）：六层加权聚合引擎（384爻→64卦→8宫→四象→三才→两仪→太极），纯 JS 零求解器依赖
plugins.readme_text:
# 道一-易经推演（dsh-daoyi-yijing）

通用决策辅助 DSH 插件（**决策辅助，非迷信**）。把任意决策事项拆解为可量化检查点，套入
六层推演框架（384 爻 → 64 卦 → 8 宫 → 四象 → 三才 → 两仪 → 太极），输出结构化结论与
易经风格研判。结论由用户输入的参数与阈值决定，可追溯、可审计。

> 原名「易经推演-万事决」（dsh-yijing-wanshijue），v0.3.0 起重命名为「道一-易经推演」。

## 双向云模型推演闭环（§2.1）
- **正向分解 L1→L7**：1 个问题目标 → 逐层调用云模型拆解 → 384 个关键考虑因数。
- **反向聚合 L7→L1**：384 因数 → 逐层聚合 → 1 个可定/否定结论（可行 / 有条件可行 / 不可行）。
- 云模型是“翻译器”而非“裁判”：**判定与聚合（L7→L2）为确定性规则，云模型不介入 verdict 决策**。

## 内置剧本
- `motor-design`：**电机电磁设计·万事决**（从 MotorDesign `Core/yijing_*` Python 原型 1:1 移植）。
  真实 8 技术领域 × 8 子领域 × 6 检查点 = **384 爻**；其中 158 项为外部数据域（NA，排除出聚合、计入覆盖率），
  **226 活跃检查点**进聚合。含强关联一票否决、六层加权聚合、天/地/人三才分组。
- `stock-trend`：**股票趋势研判·万事决**（8 股票分析域 × 64 子域 × 384 爻）：
  基本面/技术面/资金面/消息面/行业面/宏观面/估值面/风险面，三才分组为
  天(基本面/行业/宏观)·地(技术/资金/估值)·人(消息/风险)。
- `demo-384`：规范 384 结构演示剧本（verify 向量）。
- 自定义剧本：经 `yijing_script_load` 提交 JSON，落盘 `data/scripts/` 持久化（重启回灌）。

## 快速开始
```
# 安装到 DSH（web profile；dsh 未进 PATH 时用 npx）
npx -y @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-daoyi-yijing

# 本地离线自检（零依赖）
node scripts/verify.mjs          # 离线自检（27 项断言）
node scripts/runtime-check.mjs   # DSH Runtime 联调预演（纯 run* 函数）
node scripts/_mock_llm_test.mjs  # 云模型适配器 e2e（mock 服务器，无需密钥）
node scripts/_selftest_llm_quota.mjs # LLM 调用计数闸门 + 自定义模型 + session 解析自检
node scripts/_probe_definetool.mjs   # 真实 defineTool 编译器校验（需准备 node_modules，见脚本头注）
node scripts/divine_stock_600711.mjs   # 盛屯矿业(600711) 一个月涨跌推演示例
```
安装后对模型说「推演：我要不要接这个 200kW 电机外包项目」即可触发 `yijing_divine`。

## 工具
- `yijing_divine` 主入口（支持 `model` 参数按调用覆盖模型）
- `yijing_script_list` 列剧本 · `yijing_script_load` 加载自定义剧本 · `yijing_report` 详报
- `yijing_model_list` 列全部可选模型 + 当前选择 + 今日 LLM 调用额度快照（只读，不消耗额度）

## 云模型接线（v0.3.4 已接通真实 LLM）
**未配置时完全离线**：分解返回结构化因数清单、结论走确定性模板（断网也能跑，verdict 不受影响）。
**配置后由真实 LLM 生成** L1→L7 分解文案与 L1 卦象总评（判定/聚合仍为确定性代码）：

| 方式 | 做法 |
|------|------|
| 环境变量（推荐，密钥不落盘） | `DAOYI_LLM_API_KEY=sk-xxx DAOYI_LLM_PROVIDER=deepseek node scripts/divine_with_llm.mjs "决策事项" commercial` |
| 插件配置 | `cordis.patch.yml` / Config：`cloudModelEnabled: true` + `cloudModelProvider` + `cloudModelApiKey` + `cloudModelName` |
| 代码注入 | `setCloudModelAdapter(fn)`（测试 / DSH Runtime） |
| **DSH 会话当前模型（v0.5.1 起默认自动）** | 对话中被调用时**自动使用当前对话的模型**——Runtime 注入 `config.sessionModel`（或 env `DAOYI_LLM_SESSION_*`）即生效，**无需手动开 `cloudModelEnabled`、无需自备 Key**。关闭：`cloudModelAutoSession: false`（或显式 `cloudModelEnabled: false`）；自备 `apiKey` 时不抢会话模型 |

- 厂商预设：`deepseek`(deepseek-chat) / `qwen`(qwen-max) / `glm`(glm-4-plus) / `moonshot`(moonshot-v1-8k) /
  `minimax`(abab6.5s-chat) / `openai`(gpt-4o-mini) / `custom`（自填 Base URL，任意 OpenAI 兼容端点）。
- **自定义模型清单（v0.3.4）**：`cloudModelCustomModels` 传 JSON 数组
  `[{"name":"my-gpt","label":"我的 GPT","baseUrl":"https://api.example.com/v1","model":"gpt-4o","keyEnv":"OPENAI_API_KEY"}]`
  （env `DAOYI_LLM_CUSTOM_MODELS` 同构）；`name` 即选用 id，`yijing_divine`/`yijing_report` 的 `model` 参数
  或 `cloudModelProvider` 传它即可热切换；`yijing_model_list` 随时查清单与当前选择。
- 环境变量：`DAOYI_LLM_ENABLED` / `DAOYI_LLM_PROVIDER` / `DAOYI_LLM_API_KEY` / `DAOYI_LLM_MODEL` / `DAOYI_LLM_BASE_URL`。
- 安全：API Key 只从 config/env 读取，**绝不出现在日志与回传中**；`telemetryEnabled` 默认关。
- 任何失败（401 / 超时 / 断网）自动降级为确定性模板，推演结论依然成立。

## 免费额度闸门（v0.4.2 起：每分钟速率 + 队列等待）
- **主节流 = 每分钟速率限制**（v0.4.2 变更）：免费 LLM 调用默认上限 **10 次/分钟**（滑动窗口 60s，
  `freeLlmPerMinute` / env `DAOYI_LLM_FREE_PER_MINUTE` 可调，0=不限制）。窗口满时后来的调用**进入 FIFO 队列排队等待**，
  待最早的时间戳滑出窗口后逐个补位——**超出不拒绝、不降级**，仅延迟。
- **每日硬上限降级为可选兜底**：`freeLlmDailyLimit` 默认 **0（关闭）**；仅显式配置 >0 时作为每日总闸，用尽才降级离线模板。
- **计数口径**：每次真实 LLM 外发计 1 次（一次 `yijing_divine` = decompose + conclude = **2 次**；离线推演不计数、不花钱）。
- **本地硬闸**：计数/限速只认本地 `$DSH_HOME/storages/dsh-daoyi-yijing/llm-quota.json`
  （env `DAOYI_LLM_QUOTA_FILE` 可覆盖），**断网也拦**，无任何后端请求/遥测。
- **可观测**：`evaluate` 结果 `llm.rate` 暴露 `{rateLimit, queued, waitMs}`；发生过排队时 `llm.notice` 提示等待时长；
  `yijing_model_list` 可查额度快照（只读）。
- **运维旁路**：`freeQuotaEnabled: false` → 不限速、不排队、不计数。
- 详见 `docs/ENGINEERING.md`「免费额度闸门」节与 `CHANGELOG.md` 0.4.2 条目。

## 64 卦判词库（v0.5.0 补全）
- 离线结论文案不再只有「verdict 三选一」：`lib/yijing/hexagram-texts.mjs` 为**全部 64 卦**提供独立判词
  （卦辞要义 `judgment` + 行事建议 `advice` + 卦性 `tone`），文案头部形如
  「乾为天：元亨利贞，刚健不息（主动进取，忌用过刚）——本卦判：可行，刚健中正，宜进取」，
  动爻变卦行带变卦判词。
- 判词表与 `HEXAGRAMS` 双射一致、64 条互异，由 `scripts/test_hexagram_texts.mjs`（19 断言）守护。

## 可选在线模式（v0.5.0：行情适配层）
插件核心**默认离线**（确定性、零额度、断网可用）；需要实时行情时可选用在线模式：
- **适配层** `adapters/quote.mjs`：腾讯财经 `qt.gtimg.cn`（批量、免费、无鉴权），输出与基线同构的
  子域信号 `{code, subIdx, delta}`。归一化规则透明（`RULES_TEXT` 导出）：
  GZ01 绝对估值（PE 分段锚定，便宜→阳/贵→阴，**亏损→NA**）、JS01 趋势方向（收盘位置居中化）、
  JS02 动量强度（同基线）、JS04 量能配合（换手分档×当日方向）、JS08 波动特征（振幅分档）；
  **JB/HG 无字段 → NA，不造假填充**。
- **断网/超时/字段缺失 → 回退 NA**；整体取数失败 → 调用方整体回退基线（测试验证回退后趋势与离线逐只一致）。
- **取数器可注入**：默认全局 `fetch`；代理环境（undici 不读代理变量）用
  `createCurlFetcher({ proxy: 'http://127.0.0.1:xxxx' })`。
- **批处理用法**：`node scripts/divine_batch_stocks.mjs --live` → 输出 `logs/stock-batch-results-live.json`。
- **实测**（2026-10-21 腾讯真实行情 56/56）：卦象种类 5 → **8**、GZ 域 37/56 激活、平均覆盖率 6.8% → 11.2%；
  但单期上限为 2⁵=32（HG 宏观是市场级常量、JS/ZJ/HY 价类域彼此相关），干净 64 结构上不可达——
  补数据的价值在多因子研判质量，卦象变多只是副产品。

> ⚠️ 股票推演结果由公开数据映射的因子评分驱动，属结构化多因子研判示意，**不构成任何投资建议**。

plugins.description: 我们自己维护、适配 dsh 0.2.1-rc.2 的 Codex↔DSH 双向同步插件（派生自 Walvez/dsh-codex-sync，MIT，鸣谢上游）
plugins.readme_text:
# ⚡ dsh-codex-sync **Two-way Codex↔DSH bridge: skills from `~/.codex/skills`, session import with workspace attach, live MCP mirroring of `mcp_servers`, and a Codex-side reverse MCP installer.**
*2-way project chat sync · Live Skills mount · Auto MCP mirroring · Native modern UI*

English • 简体中文

[![CI](https://github.com/AI8888-SHOP/dsh-codex-sync/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/AI8888-SHOP/dsh-codex-sync/actions) [![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/dsh-0.2.1--rc.2%20%7C%200.2.0--rc.2-4B32C3?style=flat-square)](docs/COMPATIBILITY.md) [![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-%3E%3D20.0-339933?style=flat-square&logo=node.js&logoColor=white)](package.json) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg?style=flat-square)](LICENSE) > **This repository is our own build of the plugin, adapted to our DSH runtime.** > It is based on / forked from **[Walvez/dsh-codex-sync](https://github.com/Walvez/dsh-codex-sync)** > (MIT © 2026 Walvez) — see [Credits & upstream attribution](#-credits--upstream-attribution). > What we changed and why: [docs/LOCAL-ADAPTATION.md](docs/LOCAL-ADAPTATION.md). > Upstream npm package `dsh-codex-sync` belongs to the original author and is **not** this build.
🎛️ Native Sync Settings Modal
 📍 Sidebar Workspace Trigger
📥 Import from Codex by Project
 📤 Export DSH Chats to Codex
--- ## 🤔 Why dsh-codex-sync? When using OpenAI Codex, developers build up significant workflow assets: 1. **Rich project chat histories** with complete code contexts, architecture decisions, and debugging steps; 2. **Custom Skills libraries** under `~/.codex/skills` with tailored instructions and scripts; 3. **Configured MCP toolchains** for databases, web searches, and browser automation. When adopting or exploring **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)**, developers typically face major friction: - **Lost conversation history**: Incompatible session formats prevent resuming past Codex tasks in DSH; - **Configuration duplication and drift**: Skills and MCP servers must be manually recreated and maintained in two separate tools; - **One-way dead ends**: Most migration scripts are one-time destructive copies that offer no clean way to safely bring DSH continuations back to Codex. **`dsh-codex-sync` eliminates this friction completely.** It is not a throwaway migrator, but a production-grade, continuous two-way bridge between Codex and DSH. --- ## ✨ Key Highlights ### 1. 💬 Two-Way Safe Project Chat Portability (Codex ⇄ DSH) - **Import from Codex**: - Browse conversations grouped by workspace folder in an intuitive project tree; - Preserves user prompts, assistant outputs, reasoning traces, and tool-call trajectories; - Automatically attaches imported sessions to matching workspaces for **seamless continuation**; - Incremental re-import: Codex conversations continued after the initial import are marked as `updated` and append only new turns without creating duplicate sessions. - **Export to Codex**: - Export DSH native conversations or continuations back into Codex; - Automatically matches Codex's workspace catalog, gracefully locking unknown directories to prevent orphan threads; - Creates clean, standalone Codex rollouts (`history_mode: legacy`) and SQLite index entries **without modifying or overwriting original Codex histories**; - View and continue chats in Codex immediately after restarting the Codex app. - **Sub-Agent Thread Filtering**: - Hides internal sub-agent threads by default to keep the conversation list focused; - Easily expand and nest sub-agents under parent threads for selective, independent export. ### 2. ⚡ Live First-Class Skills Mounting - Mounts `~/.codex/skills/*/SKILL.md` directly into DSH's native skill catalog; - Full support for nested directory resources and multi-file skill bundles; - **Zero-restart updates**: Edit a skill file on disk, and DSH recognizes the change on the next turn. ### 3. 🔌 Automated Bidirectional MCP Mirroring - **Codex → DSH**: Watches `~/.codex/config.toml` live, dynamically mirroring `[mcp_servers.*]` to DSH with conflict avoidance and stderr silencing; - **DSH → Codex (Reverse Bridge)**: Single-command setup (`npx dsh-codex-sync codex-install`) equips your Codex agent with tools to search, inspect, and install DSH plugins. ### 4. 🎨 Native Modern UI Experience - **Adaptive Sidebar Trigger**: Sits right beside the workspace header when expanded, and aligns below the search button when collapsed; - **Centered Modal Panel**: High-contrast, backdrop-blurred settings card with intuitive action cards, real-time switch feedback, and zero UI cutoff; - **Polished Design Integration**: Uses native DSH design tokens (`--dsw-alias-*`), pure CSS transitions with zero hover artifacts, and responsive text truncation. --- ## 🧭 Supported DSH versions Version pinning lives in `package.json` → `peerDependencies["@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client"] = "^0.0.1-rc.1 || ^0.2.0-rc.2"`, which is what the DSH install gate (`evaluatePluginCompatibility()` in `@deepseek-ai/dsh-app-boot`) checks. | DSH runtime | Status | Evidence | |---|---|---| | **`0.2.1-rc.2`** | ✅ **Verified on our machine** (Linux, `web` profile) | 61/61 tests; cold boot on an isolated `DSH_HOME`; client bundle served; 5 mirrored Codex MCP servers; 123-session import dry-run | | `0.2.0-rc.2` | ✅ Verified by upstream v1.6.2 | upstream CI host-boot smoke | | other `0.2.x` | ⚠️ Allowed by the peer range, not re-verified here | — | | `0.0.1-rc.1` … `0.0.x` | ⚠️ Legacy MCP-client peer, unmaintained path | upstream `1.x` legacy peer | - **Node.js**: `>=20`. Node 20 needs the `zstd` CLI for checksummed compression; Node 22+/24 uses native Zstandard. - If a future DSH release is rejected by the install gate, update the peer range (or pin) here and re-run `npm test`. - Nuance: `engines.dsh` is **not** set, so the gate evaluates the peer range above; upstream used an exact `0.2.0-rc.2` pin, which is exactly why `0.2.1-rc.2` refused to install before this build. --- ## 📦 Quick Start ### 1. Install in DSH From this repository (packed tarball — recommended, it is what `scripts/install-local.sh` does): ```bash git clone https://github.com/AI8888-SHOP/dsh-codex-sync.git && cd dsh-codex-sync npm test # release gate: must be 61/61 green npm pack # → dsh-codex-sync-.tgz dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-codex-sync-.tgz ``` Or straight from GitHub, or one-shot from the script: ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add github:AI8888-SHOP/dsh-codex-sync scripts/install-local.sh # pack + install + config row + self-check ``` Then override the row's config in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`. `dsh plugin add` already lists the package in `dsh.profile.bundles`, so target the row **by id** (do **not** add an `insert` row for the same id — that collides with the bundle patch: `duplicate loader entry id`): ```yaml - id: codex-sync config: maxSkills: 30 mcpMirrorDeny: - node_repl mcpMirrorSilent: - exa ``` ### 2. Configure Codex Reverse MCP Bridge (Optional) ```bash # Register [mcp_servers.dsh-plugins] in ~/.codex/config.toml npx dsh-codex-sync codex-install # Run diagnostic health

# naiwa-laugh

让 [奶蛙桌宠](https://github.com/yugh6/Naiwa) 在 **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)** 每轮回答结束时捧腹大笑一次的插件。

> 本项目**不包含**奶蛙桌宠的 exe、`素材.nwp`、音频或任何形象素材——那些版权归原作者所有，请自行获取。本插件只负责「在正确的时机给桌宠发个消息」。

## 效果

DSH 一打开 → 奶蛙自动出现在桌面上（已经在运行就不动它）。
每轮 agent 回答结束 → 奶蛙播放约 14 秒的捧腹大笑，然后自己站起来。

- 桌宠没在运行时，插件会尝试自动把它拉起来
- 3 秒防抖，连续触发不会叠加
- 任何失败都只写日志，**不会影响回答本身**

不想让它开机就出现的话，在配置里加 `"startOnLoad": false`。

## 已知限制

- 子 agent（subagent）结束时也会触发一次，因为 harness 的 `agent/turn-stopping` 不带 agent 信息。3 秒防抖会压掉紧挨着的重复触发。
- 只支持 Windows：靠窗口消息和 PowerShell 触发。

## 环境要求

- Windows 10 / 11
- DSH Desktop（`dsh` 内核 0.2.x）
- 奶蛙桌宠（原作者 [yugh6](https://github.com/yugh6)，抖音：握石竹）

## 安装

### 从 dsh-market 安装（推荐）

在 DSH 的**插件市场**里搜 `naiwa` 或 `奶蛙`（分类：娱乐 / fun），点「安装」。

**不需要执行任何命令**——市场点一下，等价于下面的命令行。

### 用命令行从 GitHub 安装

不用市场、或市场里搜不到时：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:bbtnoctrl/dsh-naiwa
```

### 从本地目录安装（开发/自用）

已经 clone 或解压到本地时：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add C:\path\to\naiwa-laugh
```

装完**重启 DSH**（完全退出再打开）。

## 配置（多数情况不用管）

插件会**自动寻找**奶蛙桌宠，判定方式是「目录里有没有 `素材.nwp`」——所以就算你把 exe 改了名也能认出来。

搜索范围：

| 位置 | 深度 |
|---|---|
| `D:\` `E:\` `F:\` `G:\`（盘根） | 3 层 |
| `下载` / `桌面` / `文档` | 3 层 |
| 用户目录 | 2 层 |
| `C:\` | 2 层 |

上限 3000 个目录、8 秒，**在后台异步跑，不阻塞 DSH 启动**。找到后会把路径写进配置文件，以后直接读，不再扫描。

如果同时放了多个桌宠（比如同一源码改出来的变体），会**优先选名字带「奶蛙」的那个**。

### 扫不到的几种情况

- 放在 `C:\Program Files\` 里，或 `C:\` 下超过 2 层
- 放在没列出来的盘（比如 H 盘）
- 整个文件夹在 OneDrive 同步目录里
- `素材.nwp` 被删掉或改名了

这时手动指定即可。创建 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\naiwa-laugh.json`：

```json
{
  "exePath": "C:\\Users\\你的用户名\\Downloads\\Naiwa-main\\Naiwa-main\\奶蛙桌宠.exe"
}
```

> 路径要写到 **exe 本身**，不是文件夹。也可以用正斜杠：`"C:/Users/.../奶蛙桌宠.exe"`。

同一份配置里还能加：

| 字段 | 默认 | 作用 |
|---|---|---|
| `exePath` | 自动探测 | 桌宠 exe 的完整路径 |
| `startOnLoad` | `true` | DSH 启动时是否自动把桌宠叫起来 |

也可以在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里用 `config.exePath` 覆盖（优先级更高）。

## 兼容性

插件对两种桌宠都能用：

| 桌宠版本 | 触发方式 |
|---|---|
| 官方原版 | 模拟两次快速点击（原版靠这个判定双击）；笑完 15 秒再补一次点击让它站起来 |
| 打过 `--laugh` 补丁的版本 | 直接发 `WM_APP+3`，响应更快，桌宠自己会在笑完 3 秒后站起 |

判断方式是自动的：先发消息，700ms 后查状态，没在笑就回落到模拟点击。

> 补丁版的原版源码在 [yugh6/Naiwa](https://github.com/yugh6/Naiwa) 的 `源码/Naiwa.cs`，加约 10 行即可（`Main` 里加 `--laugh` 分支 + `WndProc` 里加一条消息处理）。

## 排错

日志：`%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\naiwa-laugh.log`

| 日志停在 | 含义 |
|---|---|
| 没有 `plugin loaded` | 插件没挂载，检查 `dsh plugin list` 和 bundles 列表 |
| 没有 `trigger via` | 事件没到，确认 DSH 版本有 `agent/turn-stopping` 接缝 |
| `auto-detect: no pet exe found` | 扫描没找到桌宠，按上面「扫不到的几种情况」手填 `exePath` |
| `exePath not configured` | 同上，配置文件里还没写路径 |
| `pet window did not appear` | exe 路径错；或者你装的是**别的变体桌宠**（窗口标题不是 `NaiwaDesktop.Source.v1`），本插件只驱动奶蛙 |
| `trigger sent but state=` | 桌宠收到了但没进入大笑，可能窗口标题变了 |

## 卸载

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove naiwa-laugh
```

然后重启 DSH。

## 许可

插件代码 MIT。奶蛙桌宠及其素材的版权归原作者 yugh6，本项目不声称任何权利，也不分发其任何文件。

---

## English

A DSH plugin that makes the **Naiwa desktop pet** laugh once whenever an agent turn ends, and brings it up as soon as DSH starts.

It ships **no** pet binary or artwork — you install the pet yourself from its original author. The plugin only sends window messages to it.

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:bbtnoctrl/dsh-naiwa
```

The plugin auto-detects the pet by looking for a folder that contains `素材.nwp` (so a renamed exe still works): drive roots `D:`–`G:` and `Downloads`/`Desktop`/`Documents` down to 3 levels, `C:\` to 2. Up to 3000 folders / 8 s, in the background. When several pets are present it prefers the one named 奶蛙.

If it cannot find yours, create `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\naiwa-laugh.json`:

```json
{ "exePath": "C:\\...\\奶蛙桌宠.exe", "startOnLoad": true }
```

Then restart DSH. Works with both the stock pet (synthetic double-click) and a patched build that understands `WM_APP+3` (detected automatically). Logs to `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\naiwa-laugh.log`.

plugins.description: Ghost-text next-prompt suggestions in the DeepSeek Harness composer — Tab to accept, never auto-sends. 回合结束后在输入框里推荐下一句话，按 Tab 采纳。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-next-hint

> When a turn ends, the composer suggests the next message by itself.
> **Tab accepts, nothing is ever sent.**

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://www.deepseek.com/harness/) plugin that brings
Claude Code–style prompt suggestions to DSH — as **ghost text** inside your own
composer: visible, undoable, and never on the return key.

```text
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ fix the two failing cases as well              Tab accept   │  ← ghost, appears on settle
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
                     ↑ only while the draft is empty; typing dismisses it
```

## Why install it

- **It knows what you were doing.** One **decoupled auxiliary request** reads the
  last few turns of *this* session — the file you touched, the test that went red,
  where the work stopped — instead of a template like "continue?".
- **It never touches your Enter key.** Accepting inserts ordinary text into the
  draft. `Ctrl+Z` undoes it; sending stays your decision. There is no send path in
  the code at all.
- **It stays quiet.** No route, timeout, rate limit, malformed output, or a plain
  "not today" all end as **no ghost** and no error surface — at most one warn in
  the log.
- **It does not ship your conversation anywhere.** The browser posts a
  `sessionId`; the host reads the transcript inside its own process, writes it
  nowhere, logs no text, and keeps it on this machine.

## Install

**DSH Desktop**: Settings → Plugins → add a git package

```text
github:xiaoshenming/dsh-next-hint#main
```

The desktop profile is owned by the app — `dsh plugin --profile desktop …` is refused by the CLI.
For a self-managed profile such as `web`:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add "github:xiaoshenming/dsh-next-hint#main"
```

Restart the app once — plugins join the roster at boot. Update from the plugin page, or:

```bash
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop && pnpm update dsh-next-hint
```

If the new version does not show up after an update, restart the app once.

## What you get

| Moment | What happens |
| --- | --- |
| A turn settles, draft is empty | One grey line at the composer's first line, `Tab accept` on the right |
| `Tab` with focus in the composer | The sentence lands in the draft, caret at its end, **not sent** |
| You start typing | The ghost disappears |
| You switch sessions | The ghost is dropped |
| Two declines / timeout / no route | Nothing at all — the correct outcome |

A model that answers "nothing to suggest" is asked once more with a stricter
instruction before the plugin gives up: one refusal never blanks the whole turn.

Tab only fires when no candidate menu owns it: with the `/` or `@` menu open,
Tab still belongs to the menu.

## Configuration

Settings → Plugins → dsh-next-hint. Every key has a default; nothing is required.

| Key | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | `true` | Master switch |
| `provider` / `model` | empty | Empty follows the session's last route; set both or neither |
| `locale` | `auto` | Language of the suggestion |
| `maxTurns` | `3` | Exchanges sampled |
| `maxInputBytes` | `8000` | Input budget for the auxiliary request |
| `maxOutputTokens` | `128` | Output token cap |
| `maxHintChars` | `48` | Hint length cap; a paragraph is dropped, a long sentence truncated |
| `timeoutMs` | `15000` | Per-call timeout |
| `perSessionCooldownMs` | `0` | Per-session cooldown; default suggests every turn |

## How it works

A dual-face cordis plugin, the same shape as
[dsh-session-surgeon](https://github.com/xiaoshenming/dsh-session-surgeon):

```text
browser   session.running true → false, draft empty
            └─ POST /api/next-hint  { sessionId }        ← id only, no transcript
host      loopback + origin check → single flight + cooldown
            └─ ctx.sessions.get(id).deriveMessages()      ← recent turns
            └─ ctx.llm.prepareCall(...)                   ← one decoupled call, cheapest effort
            └─ 200 { hint } / 204 (silent, with x-next-hint-reason)
browser  paint the ghost on line one → Tab → input.actions.captureInsertion() + insertText()
```

Deliberate choices:

- **Decide in the browser, generate in the host.** Only the browser knows whether
  the draft is empty, whether you are typing, and which session is on screen;
  asking the host to guess gets it wrong twice.
- **One request/response.** No SSE, no long-lived connections, no server-side
  cache. Cancelling is `AbortController.abort()`.
- **Official slot, own pixels.** The component mounts in
  `conversation.composer.dock`; the ghost node is ours because the host exposes
  no inline-hint write path. Unmounting removes the node, the listeners, and the
  in-flight request.
- **The auxiliary call follows the session-title recipe**: its own system
  instruction, its own timeout, the cheapest reasoning level, and a failure that
  cannot touch the main conversation.

## Related work

Two neighbouring plugins exist; neither is the same tool, but both can paint on the same
composer:

- **Same idea**: [Composer predictions (`dsh-composer-prediction`)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/10053).
  Both turn "a turn settled" into one auxiliary request and a ghost line, both decide in the
  browser and both post to a stateless host route; the seams differ
  (they mount the overlay slot, ship their own settings page, cache per session and dismiss
  with Esc; this one uses the official dock slot and drops the offer on a session switch).
  **Prefer one** — up to 0.7.6 you would get two overlapping ghosts; from 0.7.7 it detects this
  plugin and pauses itself (this plugin wins). Still prefer one to avoid version drift.
- **Complementary**: [`dsh-input-assist`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/6313)
  completes *the sentence you are typing* and checks typos; this plugin suggests *the next
  message after a turn*. The only overlap is an idle empty composer — if you see two ghosts
  there, turn one of them off.

## Compatibility

- Measured on **DSH Desktop `0.2.1-rc.2` (Windows)** and the same version's **web profile (macOS)**. The host half needs
  `ctx.llm`, `ctx.sessions`, and `ctx.webServer.register`; the browser half needs
  the `conversation.composer.dock` slot and the composer input facade.
- Still `0.x`: if upstream moves those seams, the ghost breaks first. Its position
  relies on the editor's `[data-input-scroll]` structure; a missing anchor means
  no ghost, silently.
- Requests from outside loopback are refused by the route.
- If DSH ships this natively, this plugin can be disabled cleanly — nothing here
  assumes it is the only writer of the composer.

## Development

```bash
node --test      # 49 tests, node:test only, zero runtime dependencies
```

Pure logic lives in `src/` (no cordis, no official packages, no DOM); seams live
in `plugin/`. Design decisions and the evidence behind them are in
[docs/](docs/README.md), from the line-by-line sources in
[RESEARCH.md](docs/RESEARCH.md) to the data flow and failure modes in
[ARCHITECTURE.md](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md).

## License

MIT
