plugins.description: Read DSH replies aloud with natural neural voices: sound-wave play button, sentence highlighting, pause/skip, custom highlight colours and auto-read.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-read-aloud-neural

在 DeepSeek Harness 的每条回复旁加一个**音浪按钮**，点击就能听到这条回复。voice 用的是微软 Edge 的在线**神经音色**，比浏览器自带的机器音自然得多。

朗读时会**高亮当前正在读的那一句**，方便一边听一边跟。

> Read DSH replies aloud with natural neural voices: a sound-wave play button, highlighting of the sentence being spoken, pause/skip controls, configurable highlight colours, and auto-read.

## 功能

| 功能 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| 音浪播放键 | 点一下开始朗读；朗读时音浪起伏，一眼看出正在播放 |
| 当前句高亮 | 读到哪句亮哪句，高亮底色、文字颜色、浓淡都能在设置里调 |
| 播放控制 | 暂停 / 继续、上一句、下一句、停止 |
| 自动朗读 | 喇叭开关：开启自动读新回复，关闭时喇叭带斜线 |
| 音色丰富 | 14 个中文音色，含**东北话、陕西话、粤语、台湾国语**，以及多个英文音色 |
| 语速可调 | 0.75x 到 2x |
| 智能跳过 | 代码块、表格、链接地址不念，只读正文 |
| 边读边合成 | 合成一句播一句，同时预取下一句，听起来是连续的 |

## 安装

通过插件市场安装，或者用命令行：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-read-aloud-neural
```

安装后在 **设置 → 通用 → 朗读语音** 里选择音色和语速。

## 使用

1. 在任意一条回复下方点击**音浪按钮**开始朗读。
2. 朗读过程中可以暂停、跳句、停止。
3. 想让它自动读新回复，点旁边的**喇叭按钮**开启。
4. 高亮颜色不满意？在设置里改**高亮底色 / 高亮文字 / 浓淡**，改完立即生效。

## 注意：语音来源与隐私

这一节请务必读一下：

- **语音由微软 Edge 的在线朗读服务合成。** 插件使用的是该服务的公开终端点，并模拟 Edge 浏览器的请求特征。**这并非微软官方授权的接口用法**，属于灰色地带，随时可能失效或被限制。
- **你的回复文本会被发送到微软的服务器**，这是在线语音的必然结果。介意的话请不要使用本插件，或改用系统自带语音（设置里可切换为“系统语音（离线）”，那个版本完全在本机合成）。
- 插件的本地服务只监听 `127.0.0.1`，且校验来源请求头与 Host，外部网络无法访问。
- 插件**不收集任何遥测数据**，不上报使用情况。
- 高亮功能在定位失败时会在系统临时目录写下诊断文件（`dsh-read-aloud-report-*.json`），内含少量回复文本，用于排查问题，可随时删除。

## 环境要求

- DeepSeek Harness，使用 Web GUI（桌面版）
- 需要联网（在线神经语音）
- 高亮功能依赖 Chromium 的 CSS Custom Highlight API，DSH 桌面版内置的 Chromium 支持

## 开发

插件分为两半：

- **宿主侧**（`index.js` / `tts.js` / `ws-client.js`）：注册 `/read-aloud/*` 本地路由，负责与语音服务通信、缓存音频。
- **前端侧**（`client.js`）：注册聊天操作栏按钮与设置项，负责文本分句、播放调度、句子高亮。

不依赖任何第三方包，WebSocket 客户端（`ws-client.js`）是自己实现的，因为该语音服务要求自定义握手请求头。

跑测试：

```bash
node smoke-test.cjs   # 偏好设置、按钮、分句、匹配逻辑
node dom-test.cjs     # 高亮定位（含 DOM 模拟）
```

## 协议

MIT

plugins.description: Encrypted, verifiable history keeper for DeepSeek Harness: snapshot, verify and restore your DSH sessions. No git, no external binaries.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-history-keeper

**Your DeepSeek Harness history comes back — and you can prove it.**

*Español: [README-es.md](README-es.md)*

> **Status: pre-alpha (0.1.0 in progress).** The engine works: `snapshot`, `verify` and
> `restore` run on real DSH logs, validated byte for byte on 8 sessions. Host plugin
> integration and live sync are the next milestones.

## The problem

Your conversations live in one place: `~/.dsh/sessions` on a single machine. If that
machine dies, they die with it. There is no copy of *why* it happened — and no way to
prove the copy you do have is intact.

`dsh-history-keeper` exists to fix that: capture the history, encrypt it, verify it, and
restore it — byte for byte.

## What it will do

| Milestone | Delivers |
|---|---|
| **0.1** | `snapshot`, `verify` and `restore` from a shared folder, with the CLI working without DSH running |
| **1.0** | live sync between machines, per-device manifests, explicit conflict handling, device pairing and revocation |

## Try it now (from a checkout)

The CLI needs nothing but Node — no DSH, no git, no external binaries.

```sh
export KEEPER_PASSPHRASE='a passphrase of at least 8 characters'

node bin/keeper.js init     --store ./vault
node bin/keeper.js snapshot --store ./vault --home ~/.dsh
node bin/keeper.js verify   --store ./vault
node bin/keeper.js restore  --store ./vault --home /tmp/restored-home
```

`restore` reproduces the host's own layout under `sessions/`, verifies every hash, and
never overwrites an existing log.

## Use it inside DSH

Install the bundle, then point the row at your vault in the profile patch:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: history-keeper
      name: dsh-history-keeper
      config:
        store: C:\Users\you\keeper-vault        # required
        sessionsRoot: C:\Users\you\.dsh\sessions # optional; defaults to ~/.dsh/sessions
        autoSnapshotOnFlush: true               # capture after each closed turn
        debounceMs: 2000
```

The passphrase is never written into the patch: export `KEEPER_PASSPHRASE` (or set
`passphraseFile`). Then, in a conversation:

```text
/keeper status     what the vault holds, what is pending, what this machine is missing
/keeper snapshot   capture new session bytes now
/keeper verify     check every object, hash and chain
/keeper help
```

`restore` is deliberately **not** available from inside DSH: it writes the live session
store, and a running host would not notice. It stays a CLI operation, with DSH closed —
that is the whole point of a recovery tool.

## Design principles

1. **No external binaries.** `node:` only — no `git`, no `age`, nothing to install.
2. **Fail closed.** No key, no sync. A conflict never writes. Encryption never degrades to plaintext.
3. **Never overwrite, never delete.** Restore only creates; anything that already exists and differs is set aside.
4. **Append-only and verifiable.** Every object is immutable and named by content; the chunk chain lets anyone audit integrity, even without the key.
5. **Copies per device, never a shared mutable file.**
6. **The transport is dumb.** A folder (or any provider) only moves blobs: it never parses, orders or merges.
7. **Auditable by you.** `verify` and a readable report — you do not have to trust us.

## Privacy

History is encrypted before it leaves the machine, and metadata is encrypted too: file
names and sizes do not reveal which projects you work on. Without the key, the store is
opaque. There is no server and no account.

## Install

Not published yet. When 0.1 ships:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-history-keeper
```

## Compatibility

Developed against DeepSeek Harness `0.2.0-rc.2`. The bundle declares
`engines.dsh` so an incompatible host refuses it instead of misbehaving.

## Development

```sh
node --test "test/*.test.mjs"   # unit tests, no dependencies to install
npm run guard                   # refuses committed session logs
```

Design notes and roadmap: [`docs/`](docs/).

## License

MIT

plugins.description: A persistent plugin rail for DeepSeek Harness: plugin navigation gets its own slim column, leaving the sidebar to sessions and workspaces.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-two-pane-sidebar

A persistent **plugin rail** for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) — it moves the
plugin navigation out of the main sidebar into a slim column of its own, leaving the sidebar to do
one job: new session, workspaces, sessions.

```
┌──────────────┬────────────────────┬─────────────────────┐
│  plugin rail │  sidebar           │  conversation       │
│  (52/208 px) │  new session       │                     │
│  ──────────  │  workspaces        │                     │
│  ▣ plugins   │    search          │                     │
│  ▣ market    │    ▣ workspace A   │                     │
│  ▣ tasks     │    ▣ workspace B   │                     │
│  ▣ skills    │  sessions          │                     │
│  …           │                    │                     │
└──────────────┴────────────────────┴─────────────────────┘
        ↑ drawn by this plugin        ↑ untouched, shipped SidebarRoot
```

The rail is **data-driven**: it renders whatever is registered in the host's `sidebar.panellist`
slot (`{ id, order, label, component }`). Install a plugin that registers a navigation entry and it
shows up here automatically — no code change, no configuration. Unregister it and it disappears.

This plugin is **client-only**. It installs no Host behaviour, makes no network requests, sends no
telemetry, and never touches your sessions or workspaces. Its entire state is one `localStorage`
key.

## Requirements

| | |
|---|---|
| Harness | DSH Desktop / Web **0.2.1-rc.2** (Windows, macOS, Linux) |
| Runtime | none — plain ESM, no build step, no dependencies |
| Compatibility | declares `engines.dsh = ">=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0"`, see [Compatibility](#compatibility) |

## Install

Pick one. All three go through the Host's plugin manager, which writes the profile manifest, runs
`pnpm add`, and applies the bundle patch.

```bash
# 1. registry — not on npm yet, the name is reserved for a future release:
#    plugin_manager install_bundle target=@a-meng-e/dsh-two-pane-sidebar@0.2.0

# 2. release tarball — no npm account, a fixed immutable artifact
plugin_manager install_bundle target=https://github.com/A-Meng-E/dsh-two-pane-sidebar/releases/download/v0.2.0/dsh-two-pane-sidebar-0.2.0.tgz

# 3. straight from git
plugin_manager install_bundle target=git+https://github.com/A-Meng-E/dsh-two-pane-sidebar.git
```

Then **restart the app** (profile changes are not hot-reloaded) and reload the page.

> The spec is forwarded to `pnpm add`, so `file:` / `link:` local paths work too — that is how
> development installs work.

## Use

- Click a row to open that plugin's panel; the active row is highlighted with a left bar.
- Hover a row in the narrow rail for a themed tooltip.
- The arrow button at the bottom switches between **52 px (icons only)** and **208 px (icons +
  labels)**. It is in the same place in both widths, so it never jumps.
- The choice is stored in `localStorage["dsh.two-pane-sidebar.v2"]` and survives restarts.
- `prefers-reduced-motion` disables the width transition.

There is no mode to configure: the rail is always on, and the sidebar always keeps its own width
(whatever you last dragged it to). The rail reserves its space with a left padding on the frame, so
the conversation column gives up 52 px — the sidebar does not shrink.

## Uninstall

```bash
plugin_manager remove_bundle target=dsh-two-pane-sidebar
```

Or quit the app first, then delete the `dsh-two-pane-sidebar` line from
`~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/package.json` and its entry from `dsh.profile.bundles`. Verify before
editing: editing profile files while the app is running can trip a hot-reload race in unrelated
built-in plugins.

Nothing is left behind except the `localStorage` key, which is inert.

## How it works

`client.js` is the whole thing (~670 lines, no dependencies):

1. registers a component into the host's frame-level `shell.overlay` slot;
2. locates the layout frame (`[data-shell-overlay]`.parentElement) and sets `padding-left` on it to
   reserve the rail's column — this is the only imperative DOM contact point, and it is reverted by
   the effect cleanup;
3. reads `sidebar.panellist` through `slots.entriesOfSlot()`, subscribes to slot and locale changes,
   and renders one row per entry;
4. renders each entry's own icon component directly (the host only injects `renderSlot` into entries
   that declare children, which this one does not), behind an error boundary so one broken icon
   cannot take the rail down;
5. copies the computed background/texture/text colour of the native sidebar column onto the rail, so
   third-party skins apply without any per-skin code;
6. hides the now-duplicated navigation list inside the native sidebar with one CSS rule.

Every host interaction is guarded: a missing service, slot, or DOM node degrades the rail instead of
breaking app boot.

## Compatibility

This plugin deliberately depends on host internals, all of which can change between Harness
releases:

| Depends on | Used for |
|---|---|
| `shell.overlay` slot | mounting the rail |
| `sidebar.panellist` slot + entry shape `{id, order, label, component}` | the rail's content |
| `[data-shell-overlay]` and its parent frame | reserving the column |
| `nav[class*="_panelList"]` (hashed class) | hiding the duplicated nav list |
| `[class*="sidebarCol"]` / `[class*="_root"]` (hashed class) | following the active skin |
| `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives` → `Tooltip` | themed tooltips |
| `ctx.layout.selectPanel(id)` | opening a panel on click |

If an update breaks one of them the rail degrades or disappears; it does not corrupt data. The
checklist for re-verifying after a Harness upgrade is in
[docs/troubleshooting.md](docs/troubleshooting.md).

## Known limits

- Not a native second view container: the rail lives in the overlay layer and reserves space with
  padding. There is no draggable splitter, and the rail has exactly two widths.
- The conversation column loses 52 px; the host's `viewport < 1024` "narrow window" threshold
  therefore triggers 52 px earlier than before.
- A skin that paints somewhere other than the sidebar column's own element will not be followed —
  the rail falls back to the theme tokens for that skin.
- Icon components are rendered directly and must only depend on `{ size, active }`; anything else
  degrades to a neutral placeholder square.

## Development

```bash
# link the working copy into a profile, then restart the app
plugin_manager install_bundle target=link:/absolute/path/to/two-pane-sidebar
```

`link:` installs a symlink, so after that every edit to `client.js` is picked up by a page reload —
no build, no copy step. Locale metadata (`locale/*.json` `meta`) is read at boot and needs a restart.

Filter the browser console by `[two-pane-sidebar]`; every degraded path logs a warning there.

## License

MIT

plugins.description: Financial-model and workbook auditor for DeepSeek Harness: one office_audit tool that recalculates formulas with the bundled LibreOffice Kit and runs static checks over the recalculated values - formula errors, broken references, hardcoded constants, format and unit mismatches, balance-sheet balance, cash tie-out, ratio-table conventions and data-c
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-office-audit · 财务模型 / Excel 审计器

把「审计器」做成 DSH 插件：agent 直接调用 **`office_audit`** 工具，对任意 `.xlsx/.xlsm` 做一次结构化审计，输出 `critical / warning / info` 分级的问题清单 + markdown/JSON 报告，可选在工作簿副本里生成「模型审计」表。

审计引擎移植自 Anthropic `financial-services` 仓库的 `audit-xls` / `clean-data-xls` 清单（Apache-2.0），并按中文财务模型的实际口径改写；不依赖任何外部技能包。

```
模型 → office_audit → 重算（LibreOffice Kit）→ 13 类检查 → 报告 + 审计表
```

## 一、装了之后发生什么

- 注册一个 agent 工具 `office_audit`（所有会话可用）。
- 注入一段系统提示：当用户要求审计 Excel / 交付含公式的模型时，agent 会先调用它。
- 纯 host 插件：不新增 GUI、不改 DSH 源码、没有 npm 运行时依赖。

## 二、调用方式

```
office_audit(
  path: "/abs/or/relative/model.xlsx",   # 必填；.xlsx/.xlsm
  profile: "auto",                       # auto | financial-model | ratio-table | generic
  recalculate: true,                     # 默认 true：先用 LibreOffice Kit 重算公式缓存
  writeAuditSheet: false,                # true：在工作簿副本里写「模型审计」表
  checks: [],                            # 可选：只跑指定类别
  outputDir: "..."                       # 可选：报告目录（默认 <工作簿目录>/.audit）
)
```

返回：`summary`（三级计数）、`findings`（含 sheet/cell/证据/建议）、`report.markdownPath`、`report.jsonPath`、可选 `auditWorkbook`。

**审计从不修改原文件。** 写审计表时生成 `<stem>-audit-<时间戳>.xlsx` 副本。

## 三、检查清单（13 类）

| 类别 | 级别 | 内容 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `formula-errors` | critical | 重算后仍为 `#REF! / #DIV/0! / #VALUE! / #NAME? / #N/A / #NUM! / #SPILL! / #CALC!` 的单元格 |
| `broken-references` | critical / warning | 公式引用不存在的工作表（用 tokenizer 解析，不用正则）；外部工作簿链接 |
| `formula-consistency` | info | 同一行内公式模式不一致（归一化相对引用后比较；首尾特殊逻辑自动排除） |
| `hardcoded-values` | warning | 公式与未标输入色的常数混排（蓝字/黄底视为合法输入） |
| `number-format` | warning / info | 金额行/天数行套用 `%` 格式、比率行用金额格式（按行标签语义判断） |
| `balance-sheet` | critical | 资产总计 ≠ 负债合计 + 所有者权益合计（0.1% 容差，逐期） |
| `retained-earnings` | warning | 期末留存收益 ≠ 期初 + 净利润 − 分红（识别法定口径 vs 模拟口径差异） |
| `cash-tieout` | critical | BS 货币资金 vs CF 期末现金及现金等价物（跨表、按期间匹配） |
| `cash-flow-subtotals` | critical | 净增加额 ≠ 经营+投资+筹资；期末现金 ≠ 期初 + 净增加额 |
| `ratio-conventions` | warning / info | 内联硬编码 365/360/366；季度/年度混用；未投产期分母过小；平均余额 vs 期末口径混用；首期 `/0` |
| `data-cleaning` | warning / info | 空白（仅时间序列表）、数字存文本、占位符「-」、混合类型、重复行 |
| `outliers` | warning | 同比增速超过 2000% 阈值（可按期间类型对齐，季度只比季度） |
| `workbook-structure` | info | 隐藏工作表、定义名称、纯数值表 |

自动匹配三表行标签（资产总计/负债合计/所有者权益合计/留存收益/净利润/分红/货币资金/经营活动现金流净额……），中文表头可用；找不到对应行时静默跳过，不误报。

## 四、安装（desktop profile）

```bash
CLI="/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/Resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh"
"$CLI" plugin --profile desktop add link:/path/to/plugins/dsh-office-audit
```

然后确认 `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/package.json`：

```json
{
  "dependencies": { "dsh-office-audit": "link:/…/plugins/dsh-office-audit" },
  "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": [ "…", "dsh-office-audit" ] } }
}
```

`bundles` 里没有这一行时插件不会加载。改完确认 GUI 工具列表里出现 `office_audit`（DSH 会自动重载 profile；若没出现，重启一次 DSH）。

归档包安装（离线/换机）：

```bash
"$CLI" plugin --profile desktop add file:/path/to/deploy/office-audit/vendor/dsh-office-audit-0.2.0.tgz
```

卸载：`"$CLI" plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-office-audit`（不删报告）。

## 五、运行环境（插件自动探测，无需配置）

| 依赖 | 来源 |
| --- | --- |
| Python 3 + openpyxl | `~/.dsh/dsh-runtimes/dsh-primary-runtime/dependencies/python` |
| LibreOffice Kit CLI | DSH app 包内 `app.asar.unpacked/dsh/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/libreoffice-kit` |
| Node | DSH runtime 的 node（用于跑 kit CLI） |

可用环境变量覆盖：`DSH_AUDIT_PYTHON`、`DSH_AUDIT_NODE`、`DSH_AUDIT_OFFICE_CLI`。

**降级行为**：LibreOffice Kit 缺失时自动跳过重算，只做静态检查（断链、硬编码、格式、数据清洗），并在报告里标注「未重算」；Python 缺失时工具报错并提示用 `load_workspace_dependencies` 检查运行时。

## 六、目录

```
plugins/dsh-office-audit/
├── index.js              # host 插件：注册 office_audit + 系统提示
├── runner.js             # 探测 python / node / LibreOffice Kit，spawn 审计
├── core/
│   ├── audit.py          # 引擎 CLI（--input/--recalc/--out-json/--out-md/--write-sheet）
│   └── auditor/
│       ├── model.py      # 工作簿模型、表头/期间/标签识别
│       ├── checks_generic.py   # 通用检查
│       ├── checks_finance.py   # 三表 + 比率表专项
│       ├── findings.py   # 分级结果模型
│       ├── report.py     # markdown + 「模型审计」表
│       └── util.py       # 数值/标签/期间解析
└── test/
    └── make_fixture.py   # 生成覆盖 13 类问题的坏模型
```

## 七、自测

```bash
# 回归：fixture + 本机三张真实表（存在才跑）
node test/regression.mjs

# 只跑引擎（不重算）
PY="$HOME/.dsh/dsh-runtimes/dsh-primary-runtime/dependencies/python/bin/python3"
PY core/audit.py --input test/fixtures/broken-model.xlsx --out-json /tmp/a.json --out-md /tmp/a.md
```

`test/fixtures/broken-model.xlsx` 的期望结果是 **6 critical / 12 warning / 5 info**：critical 覆盖断链、公式错误、BS 不平衡、CF 加总、现金 tie-out；warning 覆盖格式误用、硬编码、增速、比率口径、数据清洗。回归结果写入 `test-output/regression-<时间戳>.json`。

## 八、已知限制

- 只支持 `.xlsx/.xlsm`；`.xls` 需先转换。
- 派生表（`common-size` / 结构 / 同比 / 敏感性）自动跳过金额格式、增速与三表检查——它们的行是占比，按金额口径检查会误报。
- 公式一致性降为 `info`：真实模型的首期/末期特殊逻辑很常见，报告里只作提示。
- 三表/比率检查依赖中文行标签（资产总计、负债合计、留存收益……）；非中文模板会退化为通用检查。
- 公式一致性、硬编码、格式判断是启发式，可能有个别误报；报告里给了证据和单元格位置，便于人工复核。
- 重算用 LibreOffice，个别 Excel 专有函数（如 `XLOOKUP` 旧版本、部分动态数组）可能不支持。
- 体量：默认最多扫描 12 万个公式、40 万个单元格；超大模型会截断并在报告标注。

## 九、来源与许可

- 检查清单参考 [anthropics/financial-services](https://github.com/anthropics/financial-services)（Apache-2.0）的 `audit-xls` / `clean-data-xls` 技能，按中文财务模型口径重写，未复制其代码。
- 本插件：MIT。

plugins.description: Wind financial-analysis capability as one standalone bundle: one wind_finance tool that routes a question to the right Wind data domain, executes it over the Wind meta-router MCP endpoint, and keeps a per-day receipt so the same dataset is not pulled twice against one shared daily quota.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-wind-finance

Wind 万得金融分析能力的独立打包版本。一个 bundle 提供一个宿主工具 `wind_finance`，
负责**路由 → 取数 → 按日回执去重**，让金融问题只走 Wind 一条数据链路。

## 它解决什么

金融数据散落在多处时，最常见的三类事故是：同一份数据当天被取两次（额度白烧）、
交互式对话与后台脚本各走各的通道（行为不一致）、以及拿网页数据或模型记忆凑答案。

本包把这三条收进一个工具：

- **一个入口**：`wind_finance` 先按自然语言定位到正确的 Wind 工具，再执行它；
- **一次一份**：同一天重复调用命中回执，直接返回当天已取的结果，不消耗额度；
- **一条纪律**：认证 / 额度 / 网络失败如实报错误码，不换数据源兜底。

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin add <本插件目录或仓库地址>
```

或从发布 tarball 安装：

```bash
dsh plugin add https://github.com/<owner>/dsh-wind-finance/releases/download/v0.1.0/dsh-wind-finance.tgz
```

安装后宿主会注册 `wind_finance` 工具，并向 system prompt 注入一段路由说明。
agent 侧的完整操作口径见 [SKILL.md](./SKILL.md)。

## 配置

凭据**不随包分发**。解析顺序：

1. 环境变量 `WIND_API_KEY`（或 `WIND_MCP_TOKEN`）；
2. 宿主 profile patch 中已配置的 `wind-tools` 凭据（只读读取，不复制、不打印）。

```bash
export WIND_API_KEY='<your-token>'
```

可选环境变量：

| 变量 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `WIND_API_KEY` | — | Wind API 凭据，首选 |
| `WIND_MCP_TOKEN` | — | `WIND_API_KEY` 的别名 |
| `WIND_MCP_ENDPOINT` | `https://mcp.wind.com.cn/vserver_wind_tools/mcp/` | 私有化部署时的元路由端点 |
| `WIND_MCP_SKILL_DIR` | `~/.agents/skills/wind-mcp-skill` | 批处理模式使用的 CLI 目录 |
| `DSH_HOME` | `~/.dsh` | 宿主 home，回执与缓存写在其下 |

## 用法

```jsonc
// 1) 定位工具
{ "question": "贵州茅台最新成交价和涨跌幅" }

// 2) 执行取数
{ "tool_name": "get_stock_price_indicators",
  "params": { "windcode": "600519.SH", "indexes": "中文简称,最新成交价,涨跌幅" } }

// 批处理（定时任务 / 脚本）
{ "mode": "batch", "server_type": "stock_data",
  "tool_name": "get_stock_price_indicators",
  "params": { "windcode": "600519.SH" } }
```

返回里的 `cached: true` 表示命中当天回执、结果来自当天早先的取数，不是估算值。

## 状态文件

```
$DSH_HOME/wind-finance/
  receipts/<YYYY-MM-DD>.json   # 当天每次调用的回执（成功/失败、耗时、工具名）
  cache/<YYYY-MM-DD>/*.json     # 对应的响应缓存，供当天复用
```

回执与缓存写在插件包之外，不污染包目录，也不会被打进发布产物。

## 验证

```bash
node --check index.js
node --check runner.js
node test/smoke.mjs            # 离线：结构与契约检查
WIND_SMOKE_LIVE=1 node test/smoke.mjs   # 联机：真实取一次数
```

## 发布前检查

- [ ] 无本机绝对路径、无客户名、无凭据、无 `__pycache__` / 二进制
- [ ] `node --check` 通过，`test/smoke.mjs` 全绿
- [ ] `WIND_API_KEY` 未出现在任何提交文件中

## 许可与依赖

宿主侧零 npm 依赖，只用 Node 内置模块。Wind 数据服务由 Wind 官方提供，
凭据与调用额度由使用者自行申请，详见 [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](./THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)。

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: out-of-band progress narration for the Web UI and dsh-tui
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-progress-summary

[![test](https://github.com/tastynoob/dsh-progress-summary/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/tastynoob/dsh-progress-summary/actions/workflows/test.yml)

Out-of-band progress narration for DeepSeek Harness: a cheap auxiliary model turns the live
chain of thought into one short status line, shown above the composer in the Web UI and on the
dsh-tui status line.

## Where it shows

- **Web**: the row above the composer (the input dock), not the transcript's process rows.
- **dsh-tui**: the keyed status line above the prompt.
- **Switch**: Settings → General → **Show progress summary**. Turning it off cancels every
  auxiliary call and clears the TUI row immediately.
- Other knobs (model, interval, token floor, language) live on the plugin's page in Plugins.

The transcript's four work-details modes are untouched; this plugin does not add a fifth mode.

## Why out-of-band

Codex-style progress text comes from a model-side channel (`reasoning.summary` plus `commentary`
messages). DeepSeek exposes only raw `reasoning_content`, so there are two ways to approximate it:

- **Prompt nudging** (what the existing working-activity / progress-narrator plugins do): ask the
  main model to narrate each step. Cheap, but it competes with the task for output budget, and
  OpenAI's own Codex migration guide recommends removing exactly this kind of preamble prompt.
- **Out-of-band narration** (this plugin): the main model is untouched; a second, tiny request
  reads the recent reasoning and writes one line.

The cost is an extra call; the benefit is that the task never competes with its own status text.

## Trigger policy

Two layers: **free lines** update at every boundary, **model lines** fire only before a tool call.

| Trigger | Output | Cost |
|---|---|---|
| Turn start (opt-in) | "Analyzing the request" | 0 |
| Every tool call (opt-in) | a line derived from the tool name and arguments | 0 |
| **Before a tool call**, with both floors met | one sentence from the auxiliary model | 1 call |
| Turn end | idle, clearing both surfaces | 0 |

The model line requires both:

1. **Time**: at least `minIntervalMs` since the last model line (default 20s).
2. **Tokens**: at least `minTokens` of new reasoning since then (default 600; `charsPerToken`
   defaults to 3, so roughly 1800 characters).

A tool call is the only trigger that starts a model line because it is the one point where the
preceding chain of thought is known to be complete: the model has committed to an action. A pause
in the stream proves nothing (network jitter, a provider that emits two tokens and stalls, ordinary
tokenization gaps), which is why there is no timer-based trigger.

Below either floor the material stays buffered and the next tool boundary re-checks. A failed call
returns the consumed characters and retries at the next boundary. Turns without tool calls get no
model line at all — a deliberate trade: rather than cut into a reasoning block, stay quiet.

The two free rows are off by default (`quickLines: false`): the dock is a summary surface, not a
second command log. The prompt also forbids naming tools, commands, or paths, because the
transcript already shows every call.

Caps: `maxPerTurn` (default 40) calls per turn, 96 output tokens per call, `effort=off`.

## Install

### From a git tag (no registry needed)

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add "github:tastynoob/dsh-progress-summary#v0.1.0"
dsh plugin --profile dsh-tui add "github:tastynoob/dsh-progress-summary#v0.1.0"   # optional
```

`dsh plugin add` forwards the spec to pnpm, so any pnpm git form works:
`github:user/repo#tag`, `git+https://github.com/user/repo.git#tag`, or the plain
`https://github.com/user/repo#tag`. The tag pins the version; the package has no build step, so
pnpm clones it and installs its dependencies from the registry.

### From npm (once published)

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-progress-summary
dsh plugin --profile dsh-tui add dsh-progress-summary   # optional: TUI
```

The package declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, so `dsh plugin add` appends it to the profile's bundle
list; `cordis.patch.yml` inserts the `progress-summary` row and `dsh.client` makes the Web client
load the browser half. The plugin deliberately depends on **no DSH core package**: the session
module and the record-append function come from the Loader's own module instance at runtime, so
installing it can never shadow the host's core packages with different versions.

Remove with `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-progress-summary`.

### Local development (`link:`)

```bash
npm install --omit=dev
dsh plugin --profile web add "link:$PWD"
```

`link:` is a development convenience: the profile holds a symlink, so a source edit plus a restart
is enough. It has no bearing on publishing.

## Configuration

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | Master switch; also the Settings toggle (live) |
| `provider` / `model` | `auto` | `auto` follows the session's own route; otherwise pin a route |
| `effort` | `off` | Reasoning effort for the auxiliary call |
| `maxTokens` | `96` | Output cap for one line |
| `timeoutMs` | `8000` | Abort a single call after this long |
| `minIntervalMs` | `20000` | Time floor between two model lines (live) |
| `minTokens` | `600` | Token floor at a tool boundary (live) |
| `charsPerToken` | `3` | Divisor used for the token estimate |
| `excerptChars` | `700` | Reasoning tail sent to the model |
| `maxLineChars` | `128` | Hard cap for the rendered line (characters) |
| `maxPerTurn` | `40` | Hard cap on auxiliary calls per turn (live) |
| `lang` | `auto` | `auto` follows the host locale; `zh` / `en` pin it |
| `publish` | `true` | Commit ignorable records so the Web UI receives lines |
| `tui` | `true` | Contribute the line to a composed TUI |
| `quickLines` | `false` | Opt into the free turn-start/per-tool lines |
| `subagents` | `false` | Narrate subagent sessions too |
| `debug` | `true` | Append a bounded diagnostics log under `~/.dsh/` |

Fields marked live are volatile: a save takes effect on the next tool boundary, without a restart.

## How each surface receives the line

- **Web**: the host commits `plugin:progress-summary/line` (an ignorable record, safe for resume),
  which folds into the `progressSummary` session projection. The browser reads it with
  `useProjection`; nothing is written to the model-visible history.
- **dsh-tui**: `ctx.tuiStatus.set('progress-summary', line)`, cleared at turn end. This path does
  not need the record at all.

Both profiles load the same package; only the available services differ.

## Implementation notes

- Records are committed from a microtask: `session/event` listeners run inside the session's own
  commit, where a second append is refused as re-entrant.
- The commit function is taken from the Loader entry for `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session`
  (`entry.moduleNamespace`), because path-resolved copies are separate ESM instances whose private
  `Session` brand does not match the live session objects.
- The auxiliary route defaults to the session's logged `request/header` route, so no separate
  credentials or model catalog entry is needed.
- A process that starts mid-turn (a restart while a turn is running) adopts that turn at the first
  tool boundary instead of staying silent until the next turn.

## Known limitations

- One ignorable record is committed per published line (roughly 10–20 per turn at the defaults);
  set `publish: false` to keep the log clean, at the cost of the Web line.
- Turns with no tool call produce no model line.
- The line is capped at 128 characters and rendered on at most two lines.
- A misconfigured provider/model fails silently; the UI simply has no line.

## Tests

```bash
npm test      # node --test, 35 cases
npm run check # syntax check of every runtime file
```

# Tentacle

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Tentacle is a curated plugin bundle for [DeepSeek Harness (DSH)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).

The name is the mission. DSH is a single-user local agent; Tentacle gives it arms into the world — identity and isolation for many users, IM channels for eight platforms, an expert library, expert teams, SSO, and whatever else lets it reach people, services and data. Installing one bundle turns the local agent into a multi-user, multi-channel, multi-expert workspace, and the bundle keeps growing.

Scope is open by design: **anything that helps DSH connect is a candidate package.** A new data source, tool or platform integration that makes DSH a first-class citizen somewhere is in scope; re-implementing what DSH already does is not.

**Multi-tenant by design.** Identity, authorization, and per-user isolation are the foundation everything else grows from — not an afterthought.

## Repository layout

```
packages/
  bundle/             dsh-tentacle-bundle — the one package users install
  profile/            profile templates for one-command setup
  plugin-identity/    pluggable identity (local single-user default, login gate, DID)
  plugin-crypto/      shared crypto envelopes (scrypt passwords, token fingerprints)
  plugin-gateway/     authenticating reverse proxy: one resolver→policy→forward pipe for HTTP/RPC/WS
  plugin-tenancy/     tenant/user namespaces: user directory, invites, policies, admin console
  plugin-channels/    IM channel gateway (Feishu, Telegram, DingTalk, WeCom, QQ, WeChat, Yuanbao, Discord)
  plugin-persona/     expert library: templates, workspaces, agent-preset selection
  plugin-teams/       expert teams: team objects, templates and channel bindings, on the official agent-team runtime
  plugin-oidc/        OIDC browser SSO login
examples/             minimal runnable profiles
tests/                e2e: install/enable chain via dsh headless profiles
```

## Status

Early development, usable end to end: every package builds and typechecks cleanly, the unit suite passes, and the e2e suite drives the full install → login → multi-tenant → channel → expert → team path against a real DSH process. APIs and package layout may still change.

## License

MIT

plugins.description: Fixes the buddy / workbuddy channel 400 (code 11128, "Illegal API invocation from an unapproved channel") in DeepSeek Harness, and re-applies the fix after every dsh-our-free-model upgrade.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-tencent-channel-fix

Fixes the `400` / `code 11128` returned by the **buddy** and **workbuddy** channels in DeepSeek Harness, and keeps it fixed across upgrades.

> `请求被拦截，请重新发送` · `Illegal API invocation from an unapproved channel` · `INVALID_REQUEST`

Every new conversation dies on the first message, with nothing useful in the error. The message names neither the header nor the sentence that the gate actually rejected.

---

## What is actually wrong

Tencent's channel gate rejects **two** independent things inside the request. Both must be fixed; fixing one still returns `400`.

### 1. The attribution User-Agent

`dsh-our-free-model/adapter/kernel.js` publishes the harness identity as the request's `User-Agent`:

```
deepseek-harness/0.2.1-rc.2 (+https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
```

The `deepseek-harness` token is on the gate's blocklist. The check is **case-insensitive** — `DeepSeek-Harness/0.2.1` is rejected too. Every other UA tested was accepted, including `curl`, `node`, `axios`, `undici`, `codex_cli_rs`, `claude-cli`, `opencode`, and the empty UA.

### 2. The harness identity sentence in the system prompt

DSH's base system prompt opens with:

```
You are an AI agent powered by DeepSeek Harness.
```

The gate treats `powered by DeepSeek Harness` as a **content fingerprint** and rejects the whole request when it appears in the system message.

This one is subtle: `dsh-our-free-model` already has a fingerprint-rewriting mechanism (`rewriteTencentContentFingerprints`), but it only runs on the **gateway** path (`convertMessage` / `toMessages`). The **direct adapter** path — the one `buddy` actually uses — assembled its system message with a bare `messages.unshift(...)` and never called the rewriter. So the sentence went out verbatim.

Measured on the real endpoint:

| Request | Result |
| --- | --- |
| stock system prompt + stock UA | `400` `code 11128` |
| stock system prompt + fixed UA | `400` `code 11128` |
| rewritten system prompt + fixed UA | `200 OK` |

The same gate also rejects `Main branch (you will usually use this for PRs)`, `You are Claude Code, Anthropic's official CLI for Claude.`, and `x-anthropic-billing-header` — which is why CLI-proxy projects hit the identical error. This plugin fixes the two that DSH itself sends.

---

## Why a plugin, and not a patch

Both defects are text inside `dsh-our-free-model`. Its updater rewrites those files wholesale, so a hand edit is lost on its next update — **that is exactly how this bug comes back**. It was fixed by hand once, returned after the plugin updated, and had to be fixed again.

This plugin repairs the two files on every boot instead:

- Written **once**, in `apply()`, before any model request — `pack.js` and `adapter/kernel.js` are imported lazily by that plugin on first use, so the write lands well ahead of the module cache.
- **Idempotent**: a repaired file is detected by marker and left byte-identical.
- **Drift-aware**: if upstream moves an anchor, that patch is skipped and reported — never forced, never half-written.
- **Self-reverting**: files are backed up before writing and `node --check`-ed after; any failure restores the originals.

An upgrade of `dsh-our-free-model` becomes a self-healing event instead of a regression.

---

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin add dsh-tencent-channel-fix
```

Or from this repository:

```bash
dsh plugin add github:basaltfold/dsh-tencent-channel-fix
```

Then restart DSH once. The boot log shows one of:

```
[dsh-tencent-channel-fix] repair applied — applied attribution-user-agent, content-fingerprints, direct-system-rewrite. Active from the next model request.
[dsh-tencent-channel-fix] repair incomplete (upstream dsh-our-free-model changed) — drifted ...
```

---

## Commands

### `/tencent-fix`

| Argument | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| *(none)* / `status` | Patch state for all three patches, plus the resolved target and version |
| `apply` | Force the repair now; prints what landed and what had drifted |
| `restore` | Put the newest backup back, undoing the repair |
| `why` | The root-cause explanation, in-conversation |

```
dsh-tencent-channel-fix · patch revision 1
target: C:\Users\you\.dsh\profiles\desktop\node_modules\dsh-our-free-model
dsh-our-free-model: 2.5.7

OK      attribution-user-agent — Attribution User-Agent (400 / code 11128)
OK      content-fingerprints — Rejected system-prompt fingerprints (400 / code 11128)
OK      direct-system-rewrite — Direct adapter path system rewrite (400 / code 11128)

3/3 patches in place.
```

### `GET /dsh-tencent-channel-fix`

The same status as JSON, loopback-only. `405` for anything but `GET`; mutations stay on the slash command.

---

## Configuration

Optional, in the bundle row:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: tencent-channel-fix
      name: 'dsh-tencent-channel-fix'
      config:
        autoApply: true    # false = report drift only, never write
        target: ''         # explicit dsh-our-free-model directory
        verbose: false     # log every step, including no-op boots
```

`target` is resolved automatically from the active profile when empty — `${profile}/node_modules/dsh-our-free-model`, then Node's own resolution paths, then `~/.dsh/profiles/*/node_modules/`.

---

## Scope

- Touches exactly two files, both inside `dsh-our-free-model`: `adapter/kernel.js` and `vendor/channel-pack/pack.js`.
- Nothing else changes: no provider, model row, route, credential, or DSH file.
- The content rewrite is **provider-scoped** inside `pack.js` (`TENCENT_PROVIDERS = ["buddy", "workbuddy"]`), so every other channel passes through untouched.
- Attribution stays meaningful: the User-Agent remains present and non-empty and keeps its version — only the blocked token and URL are dropped.

---

## Verify

```bash
npm test        # 29 tests, no network, no real install touched
```

The suite builds targets in a temp directory from fixtures that reproduce both shipped shapes — `kernel.js` in LF, `pack.js` in CRLF — and covers idempotency, line-ending preservation, ambiguity detection, per-patch drift, dry-run, and backup restore. It also extracts the injected `sanitizeAttributionUserAgent` via `new Function` and asserts its real output.

To confirm against a live install without writing anything:

```bash
node -e "import('dsh-tencent-channel-fix/patcher').then(m => console.log(m.formatStatus(m.resolveTarget({}))))"
```

---

## Compatibility

DSH `>= 0.2.0-rc.1`. Verified against `0.2.0-rc.2` and `0.2.1-rc.2` with `dsh-our-free-model` `2.5.6` (stock, 0/3) and `2.5.7` (3/3).

If a future `dsh-our-free-model` moves an anchor, `/tencent-fix status` reports the patch as `drifted` with the reason, and the repair is skipped rather than forced. Re-derive the anchor from the new file and bump `PATCHES` in `lib/patcher.js`.

---

## Related

- [buddy-proxy#14](https://github.com/wnddd839/buddy-proxy/issues/14) — same gate, owner confirms the rejection is triggered by system-prompt wording, not headers
- [magpie#182](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/issues/182) — same `11128`, same cause

# 阿碳日报 **把选题变成按计划自动执行的日报，每期一份带时间戳的报告** [MIT](LICENSE) [![许可证：MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/%E8%AE%B8%E5%8F%AF%E8%AF%81-MIT-green.svg)](LICENSE) [![npm package](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-atan-daily.svg?label=npm%20package)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-atan-daily) [![npm 下载量](https://img.shields.io/npm/dt/dsh-atan-daily.svg?label=npm%20%E4%B8%8B%E8%BD%BD%E9%87%8F)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-atan-daily) [![DSH Web Plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH%20Web-Plugin-0f766e.svg)](https://github.com/artaniszhou/dsh-atan-daily) [![DSH 支持至 0.2.x](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-0.2.x-2563eb.svg)](#安装)
> 阿碳日报是社区维护的 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件，并非 DeepSeek AI 官方产品。 本文描述 **1.0.0**，涵盖功能、安装、使用方式与任务目录结构。 ## 功能概览 给每个选题一个目录和一份规则，剩下的事按计划自动发生。 - **定时执行**：执行时间可以用日常说法（「每天 9 点」「每周一和周四 8 点」）、五段 cron 表达式，或者干脆只手动执行；每个任务单独设置 IANA 时区。 - **一任务一目录**：每个选题就是一个文件夹，规则写在 `meta/rule.md`，任务清单存在 `task-list.jsonl`；改规则不用改代码。 - **每期一份报告**：报告按本次开始时间命名（如 `2026-10-17-090000.md`），固定宽度便于排序，同一秒内重跑自动加 `-2`、`-3`，不覆盖旧报告。 - **独立会话**：每次执行都由 Host 新建一个普通会话，旧会话自动归档；侧栏里能点进去看完整过程。 - **运行历史**：每次执行的状态、耗时、报告、会话与错误都有记录，可按任务设置保留天数（默认 7 天，`0` = 永久）。 - **补跑与排队**：休眠或停机错过的多个时间点只补最近一次；多个任务同时到点时排队串行执行，避免并发撞限流。 - **统计与搜索**：列表顶部显示任务总数、已启用、执行中、异常任务；搜索按名称或详情实时过滤，每页 10 条。 - **跟随 DSH 主题**：颜色、圆角、阴影、动效全部来自 `--dsw-*` 语义令牌，浅色与深色模式零改动。 ## 界面预览 > 截图存放于 `assets/screenshots/`，把图片放进去并保持下列文件名一致即可正常显示。 **任务列表：统计、搜索与调度状态** ![任务列表：统计条、搜索与任务行](assets/screenshots/task-list.png) **新建 / 编辑：用日常说法或 cron 设置执行时间** ![新建任务：设置执行时间与时区](assets/screenshots/task-editor.png) **运行历史：每次执行的状态、耗时与报告** ![运行历史抽屉](assets/screenshots/run-history.png) **工作目录：修改路径并自动注册为 DSH 工作区** ![工作目录设置](assets/screenshots/settings.png) ## 安装 需要已安装并能正常运行 DeepSeek Harness，版本 **0.2.1 及以上**（插件要求 `dsh >=0.2.1-0 <0.3.0`）。 ### 让 Agent 帮你安装 把这段话发给能够操作本机终端的 Agent： ```text 请把 dsh-atan-daily 最新版安装到我的 DSH web profile，使用官方 npm 源，安装后重启宿主并确认侧栏「自动化任务」下方出现「阿碳日报」。 ``` ### 手动安装 ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-atan-daily ``` 也可以打开 Web UI：「设置 → 插件 → 添加插件」，输入包名 `dsh-atan-daily` 安装。 安装或升级后重启宿主并刷新页面，侧栏「自动化任务」下方即出现「阿碳日报」。 npm 官方源较慢时可指定镜像： ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-atan-daily --registry=https://registry.npmmirror.com/ ``` 从源码或本地目录试用： ```bash git clone https://github.com/artaniszhou/dsh-atan-daily.git cd dsh-atan-daily npm install npm run build dsh plugin --profile web add . ``` 以 `link:` 方式安装时：Client 改动重新构建后刷新页面即生效；Host 改动需要重启宿主。 > 仓库不包含构建产物 `lib/`，克隆后必须先执行 `npm run build`。因此本插件不支持直接用 Git 地址安装，请使用 npm 包，或构建后按上面的本地目录方式安装。 > 若你之前用本地 `link:` 装过旧包名 `@artanis/atan-daily`，请先用 `dsh plugin --profile web remove @artanis/atan-daily` 移除，避免同一个插件 id 出现两次。 ## 使用说明 | 你想做什么 | 如何操作 | | --- | --- | | 新建选题 | 点「新建任务」，填写名称与任务详情（目标、数据来源、输出要求），再设置执行时间。 | | 设置执行时间 | 「按说法」写日常表达，「按 cron」写五段表达式，「仅手动」则只能点「执行一次」。 | | 临时跑一轮 | 点任务行上的「执行一次」，完成后会跳到它新建的会话。 | | 查看报告 | 报告写在任务目录下；「历史」抽屉里每轮记录都链到对应报告。 | | 看执行过程 | 点「会话」进入该任务的会话；已有会话会直接打开。 | | 改工作目录 | 页面顶部点「修改」，保存时会创建目录并注册为 DSH 工作区；运行中不允许切换。 | | 停掉某个选题 | 关闭任务行上的开关；不会删除文件和历史。 | 任务目录长这样： ```text <工作目录>/ ├── task-list.jsonl 任务元数据（唯一权威） └── A股 银行股息收集/ 任务目录 = 任务名称 ├── meta/ │ ├── rule.md 任务规则（缓存与脚本清单也在这里） │ ├── cache/ script/ 稳定数据与脚本 │ └── runs/ 每次运行的 JSON 记录 └── 2026-10-17-090000.md 历次报告，并列在任务目录下 ``` ## 工作方式 ```text 浏览器（列表 / 新建 / 启停 / 执行一次） │ HTTP ▼ Host：cron 定时 → 到点 → 新建会话 → 送入指令 → 等待完成 → 写运行记录与报告 ``` 执行发生在 Host 侧，所以关掉页面不影响定时任务。每次执行固定使用 `deepseek-flash` 模型，并以完全权限、免审批方式自动运行，请先在测试选题上验证规则再交给定时任务。 - 到点判断允许晚触发：机器休眠后迟到仍算这一次；重启只补最近一次错过的执行。 - 无执行时间的任务只能手动执行；停用的任务不参与定时。 - 执行失败不自动重试，错误写入 `lastError`，下次按计划继续；单轮默认超时 1800 秒。 ## 反馈与贡献 遇到问题或有建议，欢迎[提交 Issue](https://github.com/artaniszhou/dsh-atan-daily/issues)。请附上 DSH 与插件版本、复现步骤，以及相关截图或日志；涉及选题规则时可先删去敏感内容。 源码位于 `src`，使用严格 TypeScript，Host 与 Client 分开构建。改动后请执行： ```bash npm test # 类型检查 + 单元与组件测试 npm run build # 构建 lib/ npm run check # test + build + 两个 smoke，提交前跑一遍 ``` 界面文案同时维护 `locale/zh.json` 与 `locale/en.json`，两边键集合需一致；颜色只用 `--dsw-*` 语义令牌，不要引入独立调色板。欢迎提交改进。 ## 许可证 [MIT](LICENSE) © 2026 Artanis Zhou

plugins.description: Local-first privacy shield for DeepSeek Harness: keep plaintext local, send only placeholders to the model, restore real values in the transcript.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-privacy-shield

Local-first privacy shield for DeepSeek Harness (DSH).

Keep plaintext on your machine. Send only placeholders to the model. See real values again
in your transcript.

**Version 1.0.0** · zero third-party runtime dependencies · pure ESM · Node.js 18+

---

## What it does

DSH keeps two different records of a conversation:

| Surface | What it is | Who reads it |
|---|---|---|
| **Model-visible surface** | the messages the request is built from | the model (outbound to the cloud) |
| **Human-record surface** | the original committed session events | the chat UI and local session logs |

`dsh-privacy-shield` replaces sensitive text **only in the model-visible copy**, with deterministic
placeholders of the form `<LABEL_8hexdigits>`. Your local session logs, the chat interface, and
tool execution keep the real values. When the model replies, the response stream is wrapped and
placeholders are restored — including placeholders split across stream chunks — so the assistant
message is persisted and displayed with real values.

```
What you type:      Call 张三 at 13800138000 about 京A12345.
What the model      Call <PERSON_1a2b3c4d> at <PHONE_9f8e7d6c> about <PLATE_0a1b2c3d>.
  sees:
What you see        Call 张三 at 13800138000 about 京A12345.
  in the UI:
```

## Features

- **Model-visible masking only** — a defensive patch over `Session.deriveEventMessage`
  rewrites the five surfaces (system, developer, user, assistant, tool result) as the
  model-visible copy is derived; the human-record surface is never rewritten.
- **HMAC placeholders (default)** — `<LABEL_8hex>` = first 4 bytes of
  HMAC-SHA256(label, value); the key lives in a local file (`$DSH_HOME/shield/.placeholder.key`)
  and cannot be enumerated. `placeholderHash: legacy` keeps the old FNV-1a format.
- **Response restoration** — wraps `llm/stream` and restores `text-delta`, `reasoning-delta`,
  `tool-call-delta`, and `block-end` chunks, with a carry-over buffer for split placeholders.
- **Three detection families** — 28 entity types of generic PII/credentials (including social
  insurance, housing fund, student ID, medical record, IMEI, MAC; bank cards pass Luhn), plus
  Chinese-entity rules (organization, project, system, ID number, address, person) and a user
  term list with literal and `re:` regex entries.
- **Smart vocabulary** — `/shield scan-doc <path>` extracts candidate proper nouns from local
  documents (txt/md/csv/json/code/docx); `/shield learn` mines frequent unmatched fragments from
  local session logs. Candidates enter the term list only after explicit confirmation
  (`terms adopt`). `termsFile` hot-reloads on change (fs.watch).
- **Rules-pack import/export** — `/shield export` / `/shield import` carry the term list and
  entity switches between machines (`schema: dsh-shield.rules/v1`); `--encrypt <passphrase>`
  protects a pack with AES-256-GCM + scrypt (`DSH-SHIELD-ENC/v1`), `--pass` decrypts on import.
  A pack never contains the restore table; import validation rejects `vault/values/secrets`-style
  fields outright.
- **Term file** — `termsFile` points at a line-based word list (`#`/`//` comments, `@category`
  tags); merged with inline `terms`.
- **In-memory vault** — the `placeholder → value` table never touches disk and is
  LRU-bounded; it can in principle be rebuilt by re-running the detectors over the local log.
- **Outbound audit** — per-request placeholder counts and label distribution, plus a
  detector re-run over the outbound text to flag plaintext leaks. JSONL sink on by default with
  retention cleanup; `/shield audit [days]` queries, `audit export` writes CSV.
  Counts and labels only — never plaintext.
- **Web UI** — a dock status bar plus an expandable panel (Settings / Terms / Test bench /
  Audit / Candidates). Settings groups the 28 entity types by sensitivity with a search box and
  shows an "enabled x/y" counter; Terms shows category chips and sorts entries by hit count;
  the Test bench can show an opt-in placeholder ↔ value table (off by default); the diagnostics
  badge is hidden unless enabled in Settings; an `⟳ host-version` pill plus a "restart DSH" hint
  appears when the loaded UI bundle is older than the host plugin. Sensitive actions need
  `confirm`. See `docs/CLIENT-RPC-NOTES.md` for the RPC contract (11 methods).
- **Ops commands** — `/shield pause <minutes>` temporarily passes plaintext and auto-resumes;
  `/shield doctor` runs a check-up with OK/warn lines.
- **`shield_scan` tool** — a model-callable tool that reports masking statistics (counts and
  labels only).
- **Zero runtime dependencies.** Toggleable via `/shield on|off` and `/shield enforce|observe`.

> **Image note.** This plugin does not inspect image content (no OCR); images pass through
> untouched — handle sensitive images yourself. Text-like file block contents are masked.

> **Plaintext note.** Real values in your local logs are a deliberate design choice — they are
> what makes restoration possible. Disk encryption, backup handling, and access control remain
> your responsibility. See [docs/SECURITY.md](docs/SECURITY.md).

## How it differs from other masking plugins

Several DSH plugins mask PII before it reaches the model. The design choices here:

- **Only the model-visible copy is rewritten.** Local session logs, the chat transcript, and
  tool execution keep real values — which is what makes display-layer restoration possible.
  (Plugins that also rewrite the human-record surface trade away local readability.)
- **Placeholders are HMAC-derived** with a local key file (`$DSH_HOME/shield/.placeholder.key`),
  so they are stable across sessions but cannot be enumerated or reversed by someone who only
  sees the masked text.
- **Rules packs move between machines** — term lists and entity switches export/import as JSON,
  optionally AES-256-GCM encrypted, and a pack never contains the restore table.
- **Vocabulary mining** — `scan-doc` extracts candidate proper nouns from local documents and
  `learn` mines session history; candidates take effect only after explicit confirmation.
- **Outbound audit with plaintext re-check** — every request is re-scanned for leaks; the audit
  records counts and labels only, never plaintext.

## Quick start

1. **Install** the bundle (absolute path to this directory):
   `plugin_manager action=install_bundle target=<absolute path to dsh-privacy-shield>`
2. **Restart the DSH profile** — mandatory after install, upgrade, or uninstall
   (see *Known limitations*).
3. **Configure** in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (the shipped `cordis.patch.yml` is a
   working example; it already defaults to `mode: enforce`).
4. **Verify**:
   - `/shield status` — mode, surfaces, counts, derive-patch status.
   - `/shield verify 张三的手机号是13800138000` — trial masking (prints masked output only).

## Rules packs (import / export)

```
/shield export [path] [--encrypt <passphrase>]   # write terms + entity switches to a pack
/shield import <path> [--pass <passphrase>] [replace confirm]
                                                 # auto-detects encrypted packs; merge (default)
                                                 # or replace the term list
/shield rules                                    # show current pack summary (counts only)
```

- Pack schema: `dsh-shield.rules/v1` — `{ schema, exportedAt, plugin, entities, terms, notes }`.
- Packs contain **terms and entity switches only** — never the restore table. Still, a term
  list is itself sensitive; handle packs at the same classification level as your word list.
- Alternatively, set `rulesPack: "<path>"` in `cordis.patch.yml` to load a pack at startup,
  or `termsFile` for a line-based word list.

## Configuration

Full reference: [docs/CONFIG.md](docs/CONFIG.md). Summary:

| Field | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | Master switch; `false` registers nothing. |
| `mode` | `enforce` | `enforce` rewrites the model-visible surface; `observe` counts only. |
| `entities` | 26 types | Enabled entity types (see *Entity types*). |
| `placeholderHash` | `hmac` | Placeholder hash: `hmac` (HMAC-SHA256, local key file) / `legacy` (FNV-1a, enumerable). |
|

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness web plugin: batch-remove sidebar Workspaces (registration only — folders and session logs are kept). DSH 侧边栏工作区批量移除。
plugins.readme_text: # dsh-workspace-batch **English** · [中文](#中文) A DeepSeek Harness web plugin that removes many sidebar Workspaces at once. The entry sits at the far left of the Workspaces header — the first icon in the `search / view options / add workspace` row. ## Usage Tick rows → `Remove selected` → `Remove`. | Control | Effect | | --- | --- | | Filter box | Matches title or path; the two buttons below act on the filtered result only | | Select visible / Clear | Select or clear the current filtered result | | Select zero-session / Deselect zero-session | Select Workspaces with zero unarchived sessions | The `N sessions` badge counts **unarchived** sessions. Archiving keeps a Workspace's session slots, so showing `sessionIds.length` would advertise "46 sessions" on a Workspace that looks empty in the sidebar. Hover the badge to see `N visible / M archived`. ## What it removes **The registration row only** — one line in `tables.workspaces` plus one entry in `global.workspaceIds` inside `workspace.json`. Same effect as the sidebar row's `...` → `Delete`, except you can tick many at once. It does not delete folders, does not delete session logs, does not stop a running task. The one side effect: sessions owned by that Workspace fall under `Ungrouped` in the sidebar and stay openable and searchable. The host has no "refuse because a session is running" gate — that is the `archiveSession` semantics — and this plugin does not invent one. The protection is the confirmation step in the dialog. ## Install ```powershell cd $HOME\.dsh\profiles\web pnpm add -w "link:$HOME/.dsh/plugins/dsh-workspace-batch" ``` Or straight from this repository — public, or private with a git credential helper such as `gh auth setup-git`: ```powershell pnpm add -w "github:theTd/dsh-workspace-batch" ``` Then add `"dsh-workspace-batch"` to `dsh.profile.bundles` in `package.json`. With `patchReload: live` and `dsh-client-hmr`, the profile hands it to an already open page — no `dsh web` restart. ## Uninstall ```powershell cd $HOME\.dsh\profiles\web pnpm remove dsh-workspace-batch ``` Then drop the entry from `dsh.profile.bundles`. ## Development No build step: `lib/client.js` is what the browser receives. Save it and `dsh-client-hmr` (500 ms mtime/size poll) swaps it in within a second — no page refresh. Try it in an isolated instance, leaving real data alone: ```powershell $env:DSH_HOME="$HOME\.dsh-verify" dsh --profile web --port 3199 --no-open ``` | File | Role | | --- | --- | | `index.js` | Host half: an empty `apply()`, only there to hold one Loader row | | `lib/client.js` | Everything: header entry, batch dialog, en/zh dictionaries | | `cordis.patch.yml` | Bundle patch, one `insert` row | ## Limits - **The entry is portaled into the header, not slotted.** The Workspaces header has no in-row action slot; the only sibling slot, `sidebar.workspaces.directoryFlow`, is the directory-picking hole — occupying it would turn "Add workspace" into this plugin. So it portals to `[data-slot="sidebar.workspaces.directoryFlow"]` (marked by slot name, not by a CSS hash), follows re-renders through a `MutationObserver`, and falls back to the sidebar footer when the anchor is missing. Worst case on a future DSH layout change: the button returns to the footer. - Dictionaries ship for `en` and `zh` only; other languages fall back to `en`. Adding a language is adding one block to `DICTS`. - No "does this path still exist" check: the browser has no `stat`. That would need a read-only HTTP route in the host half. - The browser floor is the host's floor (React 18 + ESM); the plugin cannot be wider. ## Contracts No `require` of any built-in Client package; three public surfaces only: - `ctx.slots.inject` / `ctx.slots.register({ name, id, order, locale })` - `ctx.workspaces.list.getSnapshot()` / `.subscribe(fn)` / `ctx.workspaces.delete(id)` - `ctx.locale.register(ns, locale, dict)` / `ctx.locale.bind(ns)` Styling uses `--dsw-alias-*` variables (each with a literal fallback); class prefix `dswsb-`. --- ## 中文 [English](#english) DSH 浏览器插件：把侧边栏里堆积的 Workspace 一次性批量移除。 入口在工作区标题行最左侧，就是「搜索 / 视图选项 / 添加工作区」那一排的第一个图标。 ### 用法 勾选 → `移除所选` → `确认移除`。 | 控件 | 作用 | | --- | --- | | 筛选框 | 按标题或路径过滤；下面两个按钮只作用于当前筛选结果 | | 全选可见 / 清空 | 全选或取消当前筛选结果 | | 选零会话 / 取消零会话 | 选中未归档会话数为 0 的 | 行上的 `N 个会话` 是**未归档**数量。归档不清 Workspace 的会话槽位，直接显示 `sessionIds.length` 会把「46 个会话」挂在侧边栏里空无一物的 Workspace 上。 悬停徽标可看 `N 可见 / M 归档`。 ### 它删什么 **只删登记行**：`workspace.json` 里 `tables.workspaces` 的一行 + `global.workspaceIds` 的一项。等价于侧边栏行尾 `...` → `Delete`，只是能一次勾多个。 不删目录、不删会话日志、不结束任何任务。唯一副作用：原本挂在该 Workspace 下的 会话会落到侧边栏 `Ungrouped`，仍可打开、可搜索。 宿主没有「会话正在运行所以拒绝删除」的闸门（那是 `archiveSession` 的语义）， 本插件也不发明一个；保护手段是对话框里的二次确认。 ### 安装 ```powershell cd $HOME\.dsh\profiles\web pnpm add -w "link:$HOME/.dsh/plugins/dsh-workspace-batch" ``` 或者直接从仓库装（公开仓可直接用；私有仓需要 git 凭据助手，例如 `gh auth setup-git`）： ```powershell pnpm add -w "github:theTd/dsh-workspace-batch" ``` 再把 `"dsh-workspace-batch"` 加到 `package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 末尾。 profile 的 `patchReload: live` + `dsh-client-hmr` 会把它送进已打开的页面， 不用重启 `dsh web`。 ### 卸载 ```powershell cd $HOME\.dsh\profiles\web pnpm remove dsh-workspace-batch ``` 再从 `dsh.profile.bundles` 里删掉那一项。 ### 开发 无构建步骤：`lib/client.js` 就是浏览器拿到的产物。改完保存，`dsh-client-hmr` 每 500ms 轮询 `lib/client.js` 的 mtime/size，1 秒内热替换，页面不用刷。 隔离实例里试，不碰真实数据： ```powershell $env:DSH_HOME="$HOME\.dsh-verify" dsh --profile web --port 3199 --no-open ``` | 文件 | 作用 | | --- | --- | | `index.js` | 宿主半边，空的 `apply()`，只用来占住 Loader 一行 | | `lib/client.js` | 全部逻辑：入口按钮 + 批量对话框 + en/zh 字典 | | `cordis.patch.yml` | bundle patch，insert 一行 | ### 边界 - **入口是 portal 到标题行的，不是槽位。** 工作区标题行没有行内动作槽位；同级唯一 的 `sidebar.workspaces.directoryFlow` 是目录选择流程的洞，占住它会让「添加工作区」 点开本插件。所以走 portal，锚点用 `[data-slot="sidebar.workspaces.directoryFlow"]` （按槽位名标记，不随 CSS 哈希变），`MutationObserver` 跟随重渲染，找不到锚点就 退回侧边栏底部。DSH 改版搬动那个容器时最坏掉回底部，不会静默消失。 - 只带 `en` / `zh` 字典，其他语言回退到 `en`；加语言等于往 `DICTS` 加一块。 - 不检测「路径是否还存在」：浏览器侧没有 `stat`，要做需给宿主半边加只读 HTTP 路由。 - 浏览器下限就是宿主的下限（React 18 + ESM），不是本插件能决定的。 ### 依赖的契约 不 `require` 任何内置 Client 包，只用三个公开面： - `ctx.slots.inject` / `ctx.slots.register({ name, id, order, locale })` - `ctx.workspaces.list.getSnapshot()` / `.subscribe(fn)` / `ctx.workspaces.delete(id)` - `ctx.locale.register(ns, locale, dict)` / `ctx.locale.bind(ns)` 样式全部走 `--dsw-alias-*` 变量（带字面量兜底），类名前缀 `dswsb-`。

plugins.description: 毛颖——DeepSeek Harness 网文创作辅助插件：主编五帮手编排（大纲/正文/审校/设定/考据）、novel/ 文件化书稿、创作台面板、共创模式
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-maoying（毛颖）

中文 | [English](README.en.md)

毛颖者，笔也——韩愈作《毛颖传》，把一支毛笔写成有封地有爵位的臣子。dsh-maoying 把这支笔装进 DSH（DeepSeek Harness）：**一支管着一班帮手、守着一摞书稿的毛笔**——网文创作辅助插件，全部实现原创，MIT 发布。

装上之后，主 agent 变身**网文主编（创作总监）**：带七阶段工作流与六步写作法，把大纲、正文、审校、设定维护、素材考据分别委派给五个只带本行工具的帮手；整部小说就是工作区里的 `novel/` 结构化 markdown/YAML 目录（角色卡、伏笔状态机、时间线、线索板、叙事记忆）——agent 直接读写文件，**没有数据库，没有 API 层**。查「所有未回收伏笔」就是 grep 一行。

## 功能特性

- **主编 + 五帮手**：主 agent 当主编，只做规划、衔接、验收、状态推进；大纲师（outline）、写手（write）、审校（review）、设定管理员（lore）、素材调研员（research）各带本行工具随叫随到。找文件、查伏笔状态这类顺手小事主编自己 glob/grep 就办，不绕委派。
- **novel/ 文件数据库**：角色卡、世界观、科学设定三色标注、关系图、伏笔账本、时间线、叙事记忆、线索板，全部是 grep 友好的平键/顶层数组 YAML——人可直接改，git 可版本化，无迁移无运维。
- **七阶段工作流**：idea 选题 → setting 设定 → outline 大纲 → writing 写作 → review 审阅 → consistency 一致性 → export 导出。阶段记在 project.yml 的 phase 键，每完成一个里程碑主编推进并简报。
- **Writing 六步法**：衔接检查 → 出大纲 → 写正文 → 审稿 → 修改 → 定稿维护，逐章循环；配合 Collab 四步共创（设定共创 → 分卷规划 → 黄金三章 → 交接循环）把新书从零带到滚动更新。
- **伏笔状态机**：planted（埋设）→ progressing（推进）→ resolved（回收）/ abandoned（弃用），埋设与回收记章节号、预期回收章节排期、优先级分档——长篇不断线，活跃伏笔超 15 条主编主动提醒清理。
- **上下文按需取**：主编先读 index.yml 概览，写到哪章读哪章（前章结尾约 1500 字 + 该章大纲 + 出场角色卡 + 活跃伏笔节选），不把整本书塞进上下文。
- **工具面收窄**：主编只见「角色委派 + 内部检索 + 协调」白名单，帮手各带本行工具（审校只读、考据只带联网+落笔记）；每次请求的工具开销与上下文占用随之下降。
- **素材考据**：research 帮手联网检索历史/地理/专业领域素材，笔记落 `novel/research/`，区分史实/通说/演义并附来源——DSH 架构的红利。
- **创作台面板**：DSH 侧栏一键打开的全页可视化面板——概览/章节/角色/伏笔/关系图/时间线/设定/索引板/小说设置九个 tab；章节整页阅读（章纲对照 + 五维 + 状态流转）、project.yml 表单化编辑、顶栏字号五档缩放与自动新版检测。
- **CLI 兜底**：`maoying init / stats / index / export / brief / check` 六条零依赖命令管脚手架、统计、索引重建、导出、写作卡打包与静态体检。

## 快速开始

前置：**Node.js ≥ 18**、已装好的 DSH host（**0.1.7+**，见「兼容面」）。

官方插件通道——一条命令，装完重启即用：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-maoying
```

**重启 DSH（`dsh web`）**：插件启动时自动把预设装进 `~/.dsh/.agent-presets/maoying/`，并在 `~/.dsh/cordis.patch.yml` 写好声明行托管块，无需再点任何按钮。新会话的预设选择器里选「**毛颖创作 (Maoying)**」即可开写；要设为默认，在 Settings → Agent Presets 里选。

开发检出（想改插件或预设源码）用 link 形态直连仓库，改动经重启生效：

```bash
git clone https://github.com/lifangjin/dsh-maoying.git
dsh plugin --profile web add link:"$PWD/dsh-maoying"
```

只要命令行工具、不装插件的读者：零依赖 CLI 单独可用，`npx` 即跑，或装成全局命令（均为 npm 通道，与插件互不相干）：

```bash
npx maoying init                 # 免安装直接跑
npm install -g dsh-maoying       # 或装成全局 maoying 命令
```

## 怎么用

选好预设后，对主编说话即可，它按工作流自己路由：

**开新书（Collab 四步共创）**：

> 我想写一本东方玄幻，主角靠「听懂器物说话」的金手指鉴宝升级。

主编与你对齐题材与基调，委派设定管理员建核心角色卡与世界观条目，委派大纲师做分卷规划，然后把黄金三章（立世界钩子、立主角动机、立核心冲突）写出来交付。

**逐章写作（Writing 六步法）**：

> 第三章可以开写了吗？

主编做衔接检查，委派大纲师出本章大纲（含五维叙事字段），过目后派写手写正文、审校审稿（清单 + 四维一致性扫描），有问题回写手修，通过后置 accepted 并委派设定管理员做定稿维护——你只需要在决策点拍板。

**集中审查**：

> 前 20 章做一次一致性检查。

主编推进 phase 到 consistency，审校扫描冲突/时间线/伏笔/设定四维，问题按严重度排好交回写手。

用户回「ok / 可以 / 继续」即视为确认，主编直接推进，不复述确认。

## 创作台面板

DSH 左侧栏底部点「**毛颖创作台**」打开全页面板（改文件、跑流程之外，给肉眼看的驾驶舱）：

- **章节**：状态筛选 + 按单写作清单；点章节进整页阅读——返回按钮、章纲对照（Markdown 渲染）、只读正文、五维叙事字段、一键状态流转。
- **小说设置**：project.yml 的书名/作者/题材/篇幅/语言/工作流阶段/共创模式/简介表单化编辑，保存保留文件里原有注释；表单载入后 project.yml 被外部（作者手改 / agent 推进阶段）改过时拒绝保存并提示重改，不覆盖人工改动。
- **顶栏**：当前版本号常驻；npm 上有新版时亮「有新版 ↗」徽章直连发布页，旁边「一键升级」按钮直接用 pnpm 把最新包装进当前 DSH 档（仅支持 profile 目录安装；装完需重启 DeepSeek 才生效）；齿轮打开系统设置，界面语言中文/English 可切、字号六档（100%–150%）整体缩放，均立即生效并记忆。

面板只写状态（章节状态、project.yml、index.yml 重建），不改正文——正文永远归作者与主编。

## 共创模式（作者亲笔）

不是谁都想让 AI 代笔。project.yml 的 `mode` 键决定正文归谁写，三种模式一句话：`ai-draft`（默认）AI 代笔，走 Writing 六步法；`co-write` 逐章指派谁写，主编动笔前先问清本章归谁；`author-draft` 全书作者亲笔，毛颖只备料、审稿、记账，永不代写。

author-draft 下的协作循环——你只管写，交稿即接管杂务：

> 第 5 章写完了，贴给你。（正文直接粘进对话，或者说一声第 X 章写完、指个文件）

主编收稿后你会拿到三样东西：**审校意见清单**（只挑问题、不代改，改不改随你）、**账本回填**（伏笔/时间线/关系/记忆/线索五本账按你正文实际发生的记，计划外的改动也能认领，来源标 `backfill`）、**下一章章纲**（`novel/outlines/vXX-cXXX.md`，拿着就能写）。圣域纪律：`chapters/` 正文唯作者可改，agent 至多更新 frontmatter 的 summary 与五维字段，且先建议后动手。

配套命令：`maoying brief <dir> <章号>` 打包写作卡（章纲 + 前章结尾 + 角色卡 + 活跃伏笔，带去任意编辑器或其他 AI），`maoying check <dir>` 做零模型静态体检（frontmatter 完整性、伏笔章号引用、时间线乱序等，不调模型——LLM 审校走主编）。

## 方法论技能

随插件带 4 个网文方法论技能，插件启动时安装器把它们落盘到 `~/.dsh/skills/`（即 `<home>/skills/`）下的 `maoying-*` 四个目录，宿主技能面板可直接看到；大纲师、写手、审校、设定管理员按场景自动加载，你不用手动操作：

| 技能 | 一句话说明 |
|---|---|
| maoying-golden-opening | 黄金三章：前三章职能分工（世界钩子 → 动机确立 → 冲突引爆）、前 300 字出事原则、信息释放纪律与自检清单 |
| maoying-beat-pacing | 爽点节奏：爽点类型库、压抑-释放配比、单章/中/大三级节奏曲线与章尾钩子选型 |
| maoying-review-checklist | 审校清单：语言/节奏/人设/逻辑/伏笔/剧透六层逐项检查，按 P0/P1/P2 三档严重度输出 |
| maoying-foreshadow-discipline | 伏笔管理：埋设即登记、推进节奏排期、回收「意外 + 合理」标准与台账清理阈值 |

安装器只认 `maoying-*` 前缀目录，`~/.dsh/skills/` 下你自己的技能一个字节不动。卸载插件后技能目录需手动清理（四目录一起删）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-maoying
rm -rf "${DSH_HOME:-$HOME/.dsh}/skills/"maoying-*
```

## novel/ 数据规范

`novel/` 目录是整个插件的数据库：project.yml（元信息与七阶段 phase）、volumes.yml、chapters/（frontmatter 五维叙事字段 + 正文）、characters/（角色卡）、world/、science/（三色设定）、relations.yml、foreshadows.yml（伏笔状态机）、timeline.yml、memories.yml（含出场记录与承诺账）、clue-board.yml、research/、exports/。全部格式、示例与设计理由见：

- 速查版：项目初始化后的 `novel/README.md`（模板源 [templates/novel/README.md](templates/novel/README.md)）
- 完整版：[docs/spec.md](docs/spec.md)（为什么不用 SQLite、五维字段定义、伏笔状态机语义、出场记录约定）

## CLI

```bash
maoying init [dir]     # 生成 novel/ 脚手架（默认 ./novel；已存在文件一律跳过，绝不覆盖）
maoying stats [dir]    # 逐章 CJK 字数、状态分布、当前 phase
maoying index [dir]    # 从 volumes.yml + chapters/ 重建 index.yml（派生文件）
maoying export [dir]   # 导出全书：--format md|txt|epub（默认 md），--out <目录> 改输出位置
maoying brief [dir] <chapter>  # 组装单章写作卡（章纲+前章结尾+角色卡+活跃伏笔）；--out 落盘，缺省 stdout
maoying check [dir]    # 静态体检（不调模型）：frontmatter/枚举/章号/伏笔引用/时间线年份/关系卡引用
```

export 示例：

```bash
maoying export novel                      # Markdown，落到 novel/exports/
maoying export novel --format txt         # 纯文本
maoying export novel --format epub        # EPUB 3（零依赖打包，可直接导入阅读器）
maoying export novel --format epub --out ~/Downloads   # 换输出目录
```

输出目录默认 `<dir>/exports/`，文件名 `<书名>-<YYYYMMDD>.<扩展名>`（书名取 project.yml 的 title）；章节解析与 stats/index 同一套逻辑，frontmatter 不会混进正文。

零依赖（node:fs/path/url/crypto），任意 cwd 可用。装法三选一：`npm install -g dsh-maoying`、随用随取的 `npx maoying <命令>`、或开发机的 `npm link`（仓库检出即改即生效）。三样都没有时 `node <插件目录>/bin/maoying.mjs` 等价（dsh 插件安装也会把包落进 profile，可直接指过去）。日常写作中 index.yml 由设定管理员直接重建，CLI 主要给人用。

## 卸载

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-maoying
rm -rf "${DSH_HOME:-$HOME/.dsh}/.agent-presets/maoying"
rm -rf "${DSH_HOME:-$HOME/.dsh}/skills/"maoying-*
```

宿主是 DSH 0.1.7+ 时再补一步：删去 `~/.dsh/cordis.patch.yml` 里的 dsh-maoying 托管块（`# --- dsh-maoying preset managed (auto-generated; do not edit) ---` 到 `# --- end dsh-maoying preset managed ---` 之间的整段，含两行标记），免得留下指向已删目录的声明行。`novel/` 目录是你的书稿，卸载插件不会动它。

## 兼容面

插件启动时读宿主版本，按版本自动选择委派行形状——**宿主升级后重启即切换，无需重装插件**。版本探测是五级探针（argv[1] → 全 argv 扫描 → app.asar / desktop-runtime → Electron API → home 全局兜底），前四级锚定当前进程的真实宿主，`<home>/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh/package.json` 那份 home 全局安装只做最后兜底（老 CLI 残留可能陈旧几个大版本）；每级读到了什么可查创作台面板的 `host-debug` 端点（路径已脱敏）：

- **DSH 0.1.7 – 0.2.1-rc.1 → v1 内联形状**：5 个角色委派行直接内联 persona 与 toolFilter，托管块 1 条声明行。
- **DSH 0.2.1-rc.2+ → v2 AgentPreset 形状**：该版本起 dsh-tool-subagent 拒绝内联 persona/toolFilter，插件改用 [presets/maoying/agent.cordis.v2.yml](presets/maoying/agent.cordis.v2.yml)——托管块写 6 条声明行（主编 preset + 大纲师/写手/审校/设定管理员/素材调研员 5 张角色 preset），主编委派行以 `agentPreset` 指向角色 preset，角色的工具面由 preset 里的实体工具行承载（审校只读、考据带联网检索）。
- **角色预设会出现在预设选择器**（宿主对预设没有隐藏机制），name 带「（内部）」标明：日常写作由主编委派自动选用，不经主编、想单独开一个写手/考据会话时直接选中即可。
- 两种形状的 persona 文本同源逐字一致（[test/composition.test.mjs](test/composition.test.mjs) 逐字节把关）；宿主版本读不到时保守按 v1 处理。
- ≤0.1.6 的目录扫描轨道：不做（宿主已淘汰）。

## 许可

[MIT](LICENSE) © 2026 lifangjin

## 致谢
